-- The helicopter's built-in light, switched from the state bag on the helicopter.

local forwardLights = {} -- [bagName] = GetGameTimer() the helicopter was last seen
local forwardThreadRunning = false

local function startForwardThread()
    if forwardThreadRunning then return end
    forwardThreadRunning = true

    CreateThread(function()
        while next(forwardLights) do
            local now = GetGameTimer()

            for bagName, lastSeen in pairs(forwardLights) do
                local heli = GetEntityFromStateBagName(bagName)

                if heli ~= 0 and DoesEntityExist(heli) then
                    local spot = Entity(heli).state.helicamSpotlight
                    if not spot or spot.mode ~= "forward" then
                        -- switched off, or a different entity is using this bag name now
                        forwardLights[bagName] = nil
                    else
                        forwardLights[bagName] = now
                        if not IsVehicleSearchlightOn(heli) then
                            SetVehicleSearchlight(heli, true, false)
                        end
                    end
                elseif now - lastSeen > 300000 then
                    -- not seen for five minutes; the state is sent again if it comes back into range
                    forwardLights[bagName] = nil
                end
            end

            Wait(500)
        end

        forwardThreadRunning = false
    end)
end

local function setForwardLight(bagName, value)
    if value and value.mode == "forward" then
        forwardLights[bagName] = GetGameTimer()
        startForwardThread()
        return
    end

    if forwardLights[bagName] then
        forwardLights[bagName] = nil
        local heli = GetEntityFromStateBagName(bagName)
        if heli ~= 0 and DoesEntityExist(heli) then
            SetVehicleSearchlight(heli, false, false)
        end
    end
end

AddStateBagChangeHandler("helicamSpotlight", nil, function(bagName, _, value)
    if bagName:sub(1, 7) ~= "entity:" then return end
    setForwardLight(bagName, value)
end)

-- Pick up searchlights that were already on when this resource (re)started.
CreateThread(function()
    Wait(1000)
    for _, vehicle in ipairs(GetGamePool("CVehicle")) do
        if NetworkGetEntityIsNetworked(vehicle) then
            local value = Entity(vehicle).state.helicamSpotlight
            if value then
                setForwardLight(("entity:%d"):format(NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(vehicle)), value)
            end
        end
    end
end)

AddEventHandler("onClientResourceStop", function(resource)
    if resource ~= cache.resource then return end
    ClearTargetFlags()
end)

-- FiveM Heli Cam by mraes, Version 1.3 (2017-06-12)
-- Modified by rjross2013 (2017-06-23)
-- Further modified by Loque (2017-08-15)
-- Converted to ox_lib keybinds by .exe Studios (filo) (2026-02-19)

-- Spotlight state bag on each helicopter:
-- { mode = "forward" | "manual" | "tracking", operator = serverId, brightness, radius,
--   target = netId, plate = string, paused = bool }
-- Manual and tracking beams are also streamed to nearby players further down.
local STATE_KEY = "helicamSpotlight"
local MIN_EVENT_INTERVAL = 50 -- ms between spotlight events from one player
local STREAM_INTERVAL = 100   -- ms between beam updates sent to nearby players
local STREAM_RANGE = 700.0    -- sent to players this close to the helicopter or to the lit spot
local MAX_AIM_DISTANCE = 2100.0

local activeHelis = {} -- [netId] = spot table while that helicopter has a spotlight on
local aimPoints = {}   -- [netId] = vector3 the manual spotlight is pointed at
local lastEvent = {}   -- [source] = GetGameTimer() of their last accepted event
local lastAim = {}     -- [source] = GetGameTimer() of their last accepted aim update

-- Returns the recognized helicopter the player is sitting in, and whether they are its pilot.
local function getHeli(playerSrc)
	local ped = GetPlayerPed(playerSrc)
	if ped == 0 then return nil end

	local veh = GetVehiclePedIsIn(ped, false)
	if veh == 0 then return nil end

	local model = GetEntityModel(veh)
	for _, allowed in ipairs(Config.HeliModels) do
		if model == allowed then
			return veh, GetPedInVehicleSeat(veh, -1) == ped
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function throttled(playerSrc)
	local now = GetGameTimer()
	local last = lastEvent[playerSrc]
	if last and now - last < MIN_EVENT_INTERVAL then return true end
	lastEvent[playerSrc] = now
	return false
end

local function clamp(value, min, max, default)
	if type(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value then return default end
	return math.max(min, math.min(max, value))
end

local function saveSpotlight(heli, spot)
	local netID = NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(heli)
	Entity(heli).state:set(STATE_KEY, spot, true)
	activeHelis[netID] = spot
	if spot.mode ~= "manual" then
		aimPoints[netID] = nil
	end
end

local function clearSpotlight(heli)
	local netID = NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(heli)
	Entity(heli).state:set(STATE_KEY, nil, true)
	activeHelis[netID] = nil
	aimPoints[netID] = nil
end

RegisterNetEvent("helicam:setSpotlight", function(mode, brightness, radius, targetNetID, plate, paused)
	local src = source
	local heli, isPilot = getHeli(src)
	if not heli then return end

	-- switching off is never throttled, so a light can't get stuck on
	if mode == "off" then
		if Entity(heli).state[STATE_KEY] then
			clearSpotlight(heli)
		end
		return
	end

	if throttled(src) then return end
	if mode ~= "forward" and mode ~= "manual" and mode ~= "tracking" then return end
	if mode == "forward" and not isPilot then return end

	local spot = {
		mode = mode,
		operator = src,
		brightness = clamp(brightness, 1.0, 10.0, 1.0),
		radius = clamp(radius, 4.0, 10.0, 4.0),
	}

	if mode == "tracking" then
		-- passed on to other clients, so type-check rather than trust
		if math.type(targetNetID) ~= "integer" then return end
		if type(plate) ~= "string" or #plate > 16 then return end
		spot.target = targetNetID
		spot.plate = plate
		spot.paused = paused == true
	end

	saveSpotlight(heli, spot)
end)

RegisterNetEvent("helicam:pauseSpotlight", function(paused)
	local src = source
	if throttled(src) then return end

	local heli = getHeli(src)
	if not heli then return end

	local spot = Entity(heli).state[STATE_KEY]
	if not spot or spot.mode ~= "tracking" then return end

	spot.paused = paused == true
	saveSpotlight(heli, spot)
end)

RegisterNetEvent("helicam:spotlightSettings", function(brightness, radius)
	local src = source
	if throttled(src) then return end

	local heli = getHeli(src)
	if not heli then return end

	local spot = Entity(heli).state[STATE_KEY]
	if not spot then return end

	spot.brightness = clamp(brightness, 1.0, 10.0, spot.brightness)
	spot.radius = clamp(radius, 4.0, 10.0, spot.radius)
	saveSpotlight(heli, spot)
end)

-- Where the manual spotlight is pointed. Sent by whoever is operating it, about ten times a second.
RegisterNetEvent("helicam:aim", function(aim)
	local src = source
	if type(aim) ~= "vector3" then return end

	local now = GetGameTimer()
	local last = lastAim[src]
	if last and now - last < MIN_EVENT_INTERVAL then return end
	lastAim[src] = now

	local heli = getHeli(src)
	if not heli then return end

	local netID = NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(heli)
	local spot = activeHelis[netID]
	if not spot or spot.mode ~= "manual" or spot.operator ~= src then return end
	if #(GetEntityCoords(heli) - aim) > MAX_AIM_DISTANCE then return end

	aimPoints[netID] = aim
end)

-- Stream each manual/tracking beam to the players close enough to see it.
CreateThread(function()
	while true do
		if not next(activeHelis) then
			Wait(500)
		else
			Wait(STREAM_INTERVAL)

			local players = nil

			for netID, spot in pairs(activeHelis) do
				local heli = NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(netID)

				if heli ~= 0 and DoesEntityExist(heli) and spot.mode ~= "forward" and not spot.paused then
					local aim = nil

					if spot.mode == "manual" then
						aim = aimPoints[netID]
					else
						local target = NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(spot.target)
						if target ~= 0 and DoesEntityExist(target) then
							aim = GetEntityCoords(target)
						end
					end

					if aim then
						local heliCoords = GetEntityCoords(heli)

						if not players then
							players = {}
							for _, playerId in ipairs(GetPlayers()) do
								local ped = GetPlayerPed(playerId)
								if ped ~= 0 then
									players[#players + 1] = { id = tonumber(playerId), coords = GetEntityCoords(ped) }
								end
							end
						end

						for i = 1, #players do
							local player = players[i]
							if #(player.coords - heliCoords) < STREAM_RANGE or #(player.coords - aim) < STREAM_RANGE then
								TriggerClientEvent("helicam:beam", player.id, netID, spot.mode, spot.operator,
									heliCoords, aim, spot.brightness, spot.radius, spot.target)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- Switch a spotlight off once whoever turned it on has left the helicopter or the server.
CreateThread(function()
	while true do
		Wait(1000)

		for netID, spot in pairs(activeHelis) do
			local heli = NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(netID)

			if heli == 0 or not DoesEntityExist(heli) then
				activeHelis[netID] = nil
				aimPoints[netID] = nil
			else
				local operatorPed = GetPlayerPed(spot.operator)
				if operatorPed == 0 or GetVehiclePedIsIn(operatorPed, false) ~= heli then
					clearSpotlight(heli)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

AddEventHandler("playerDropped", function()
	lastEvent[source] = nil
	lastAim[source] = nil
end)

    resource = "es_extended",

    Init = function()
        ESX = exports.es_extended:getSharedObject()
        return ESX ~= nil

        local identifier = player and player.identifier
        return identifier and ("esx:" .. identifier) or nil
    end,

    GetDisplayName = function(source)

        if not player then
            return nil
        end

        if type(player.getName) == "function" then
            return player.getName()
        end

        return player.name
    end,

    HasPermission = function(source, permission)
        local player = getPlayer(source)
        return player ~= nil and type(player.getGroup) == "function" and player.getGroup() == permission
    end

FiveFly = FiveFly or {}

---@class FrameworkAdapter
---@field name string
---@field resource? string resource that must be started for this adapter to be used
---@field Init? fun(): boolean
---@field GetIdentifier fun(source: integer): string|nil stable per character, never the server id
---@field GetDisplayName? fun(source: integer): string|nil character name
---@field HasPermission? fun(source: integer, permission: string): boolean

FiveFly.Bridge = {
    Adapters = {},
    active = nil
}

local Bridge = FiveFly.Bridge
local DETECTION_ORDER <const> = { "qbx", "qb", "esx", "vrp" }

---@param adapter FrameworkAdapter
function Bridge.Register(adapter)
    Bridge.Adapters[adapter.name] = adapter
end

local function tryActivate(name)
    local adapter = Bridge.Adapters[name]

    if not adapter then
        return false
    end

    if adapter.resource and GetResourceState(adapter.resource) ~= "started" then
        return false
    end

    if adapter.Init then
        local ok, ready = pcall(adapter.Init)

        if not ok or ready == false then
            FiveFly.Log("warn", FiveFly.T("log.adapter_failed", name, tostring(ready)))
            return false
        end
    end

    Bridge.active = adapter
    return true
end

local warnedUnavailable = false

local function getWantedFramework()
    return tostring(Config.Framework or "auto"):lower()
end

--- With an explicit Config.Framework, only that adapter is ever used: while its resource is not started,
--- no adapter is active and players get `identity_unavailable` instead of being saved under another
--- identifier (which would split their data). With "auto", the first started framework wins and
--- standalone is the last resort.
function Bridge.Detect()
    local wanted = getWantedFramework()

    if wanted ~= "auto" then
        if not Bridge.Adapters[wanted] then
            FiveFly.Log("error", FiveFly.T("log.unknown_framework", wanted))
            return nil
        end

        if tryActivate(wanted) then
            return Bridge.active
        end

        if not warnedUnavailable then
            warnedUnavailable = true
            FiveFly.Log("warn", FiveFly.T("log.waiting_framework", wanted))
        end

        return nil
    end

    for _, name in ipairs(DETECTION_ORDER) do
        if tryActivate(name) then
            return Bridge.active
        end
    end

    tryActivate("standalone")
    return Bridge.active
end

local function getAdapter()
    return Bridge.active or Bridge.Detect()
end

--- A framework started after FiveFly (wrong ensure order or a framework restart) replaces standalone.
AddEventHandler("onResourceStart", function(resourceName)
    for _, name in ipairs(DETECTION_ORDER) do
        local adapter = Bridge.Adapters[name]

        if adapter and adapter.resource == resourceName then
            local current = Bridge.active and Bridge.active.name or "none"
            local wanted = getWantedFramework()

            if wanted == name or (wanted == "auto" and (current == "standalone" or current == name or current == "none")) then
                Bridge.active = nil

                if tryActivate(name) then
                    FiveFly.Log(current == "standalone" and "warn" or "info", FiveFly.T(current == "standalone" and "log.framework_late_standalone" or "log.framework_late", name))
                end
            end

            return
        end
    end
end)

function Bridge.GetName()
    local adapter = getAdapter()
    return adapter and adapter.name or "none"
end

---@param source integer
---@return string|nil identifier e.g. "qb:ABC12345", "vrp:42", "license:..."
function Bridge.GetIdentifier(source)
    local adapter = getAdapter()

    if not adapter then
        return nil
    end

    local ok, identifier = pcall(adapter.GetIdentifier, source)

    if not ok then
        FiveFly.Log("debug", "GetIdentifier failed for %s: %s", tostring(source), tostring(identifier))
        return nil
    end

    if type(identifier) ~= "string" or identifier == "" or #identifier > 64 then
        return nil
    end

    return identifier
end

---@param source integer
---@return string
function Bridge.GetDisplayName(source)
    local adapter = getAdapter()
    local name = nil

    if adapter and adapter.GetDisplayName then
        local ok, result = pcall(adapter.GetDisplayName, source)

        if ok and type(result) == "string" then
            name = FiveFly.Utils.Trim(result)
        end
    end

    if not name or name == "" then
        name = FiveFly.Utils.Trim(GetPlayerName(source) or "")
    end

    return name ~= "" and name:sub(1, 48) or ("Player " .. tostring(source))
end

---@param source integer
---@param permission string
---@return boolean
function Bridge.HasPermission(source, permission)
    local adapter = getAdapter()

    if adapter and adapter.HasPermission then
        local ok, allowed = pcall(adapter.HasPermission, source, permission)

        if ok and allowed == true then
            return true
        end
    end

    return IsPlayerAceAllowed(source, permission)
end

--- Rockstar license without the "license:" prefix, used by standalone and as a helper.
function Bridge.GetLicense(source)
    for _, identifier in ipairs(GetPlayerIdentifiers(source) or {}) do

-- The move: behind a fade, the car too when they drive one, and onto the ground when no height was given
-- (the world there is streamed in first: GTA only knows the ground of what is loaded).

local busy = false

local function notify(text, kind) exports.whip_core:Notify(text, kind or 'info') end

-- the ground under x, y: tried from high up down, waiting for the collision each time; nil when none was found
local function groundZ(ent, x, y)
    for _, probe in ipairs({ 1000.0, 800.0, 600.0, 400.0, 300.0, 200.0, 150.0, 100.0, 50.0, 25.0, 0.0 }) do
        SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(ent, x, y, probe, false, false, false)
        RequestCollisionAtCoord(x, y, probe)
        local until_ = GetGameTimer() + 400
        repeat
            local found, z = GetGroundZFor_3dCoord(x, y, probe, false)
            if found then return z end
            Wait(0)
        until GetGameTimer() > until_
    end
    return nil
end

local function go(x, y, z, heading)
    if busy then return end
    busy = true
    local ped = PlayerPedId()
    local veh = GetVehiclePedIsIn(ped, false)
    local ent = (veh ~= 0 and GetPedInVehicleSeat(veh, -1) == ped) and veh or ped

    DoScreenFadeOut(250)
    local t = GetGameTimer() + 1000
    while not IsScreenFadedOut() and GetGameTimer() < t do Wait(0) end

    FreezeEntityPosition(ent, true)
    NewLoadSceneStartSphere(x, y, z or 100.0, 80.0, 0)
    local landed = z
    if not landed then
        landed = groundZ(ent, x, y)
        if not landed then notify('No ground found there: you are left high up', 'error') landed = 400.0 end
    else
        RequestCollisionAtCoord(x, y, z)
        local until_ = GetGameTimer() + 3000
        while not HasCollisionLoadedAroundEntity(ent) and GetGameTimer() < until_ do
            SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(ent, x, y, z, false, false, false)
            Wait(0)
        end
    end
    SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(ent, x, y, landed + (ent == ped and 1.0 or 0.5), false, false, false)
    if heading then SetEntityHeading(ent, heading) end
    NewLoadSceneStop()
    FreezeEntityPosition(ent, false)
    if ent ~= ped then SetVehicleOnGroundProperly(ent) end

    DoScreenFadeIn(300)
    busy = false
end

RegisterNetEvent('devtp:go', function(x, y, z, heading)
    x, y, z, heading = tonumber(x), tonumber(y), tonumber(z), tonumber(heading)
    if x and y then go(x, y, z, heading) end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('devtp:marker', function()
    local blip = GetFirstBlipInfoId(8)   -- the player's own map waypoint
    if not DoesBlipExist(blip) then return notify('Set a waypoint on the map first', 'error') end
    local c = GetBlipInfoIdCoord(blip)
    go(c.x, c.y, nil, nil)
end)

-- chat help (whip_chat shows a command's help when it has some)
CreateThread(function()
    TriggerEvent('chat:addSuggestion', '/tp', 'Teleport (staff)', {
        { name = 'x y [z] [h] | id', help = 'coordinates (commas are fine), or a player\'s server id' },
    })
    TriggerEvent('chat:addSuggestion', '/tpm', 'Teleport to your map waypoint (staff)', {})
end)

-- /tp and /tpm. Staff only: the whip.devtools ace (group.admin has it in server.cfg). Every teleport goes on the
-- player's activity log. The move itself is the client's (it waits for the ground there, behind a fade).

local ACE = 'whip.devtools'
local LIMIT_XY, Z_MIN, Z_MAX = 10000.0, -200.0, 2700.0

local function say(src, text, kind) exports.whip_core:NotifyPlayer(src, text, kind or 'info') end
local function log(src, detail) CreateThread(function() Whip.core:LogActivity(src, 'teleport', { detail = detail }) end) end

-- "x y z h", "x, y, z", "vector3(x, y, z)", "vec4(...)": the numbers in what was typed
local function numbers(raw)
    local out = {}
    raw = raw:gsub('%a[%w_]*', ' ')   -- words first: the 4 of "vec4" is not a number typed
    for n in raw:gmatch('-?%d+%.?%d*') do out[#out + 1] = tonumber(n) end
    return out
end

Whip.command('tp', { ace = ACE, console = false }, function(src, args, raw)
    local typed = (raw or ''):gsub('^%S+%s*', '')   -- without "tp"
    local n = numbers(typed)

    -- /tp <server id>: to that player
    if #n == 1 and #args == 1 and math.type(n[1]) == 'integer' then
        local target = n[1]
        local ped = GetPlayerPed(target)
        if target == src then return say(src, 'That is you', 'error') end
        if not GetPlayerName(target) or not ped or ped == 0 then return say(src, ('No player with id %d'):format(target), 'error') end
        if GetPlayerRoutingBucket(target) ~= GetPlayerRoutingBucket(src) then
            return say(src, 'They are in another world (routing bucket): use /whip > Players instead', 'error')
        end
        local c = GetEntityCoords(ped)
        TriggerClientEvent('devtp:go', src, c.x, c.y, c.z, nil)
        log(src, ('to %s (%d)'):format(GetPlayerName(target), target))
        return
    end

    if #n < 2 then
        return say(src, 'Use /tp x y [z] [heading], or /tp <player id>', 'error')
    end
    local x, y, z, h = n[1], n[2], n[3], n[4]
    if math.abs(x) > LIMIT_XY or math.abs(y) > LIMIT_XY or (z and (z < Z_MIN or z > Z_MAX)) then
        return say(src, 'Those coordinates are off the map', 'error')
    end
    TriggerClientEvent('devtp:go', src, x + 0.0, y + 0.0, z and z + 0.0 or nil, h and h + 0.0 or nil)
    log(src, ('to %.1f, %.1f%s'):format(x, y, z and (', %.1f'):format(z) or ''))
end)

Whip.command('tpm', { ace = ACE, console = false }, function(src)
    TriggerClientEvent('devtp:marker', src)
    log(src, 'to their map waypoint')
end)

Whip.sayStarted()

local vRP

--- vRP's lib/Proxy.lua relies on globals from @vrp/lib/utils.lua: `module`, `async` and `table.maxn`.
--- FiveFly does not list vRP in its manifest, so when vRP is used it runs vRP's own utils.lua (matching the
--- fork installed on the server) and only falls back to equivalent polyfills when that file is missing.
local function loadVrpUtils()
    local code = LoadResourceFile("vrp", "lib/utils.lua")

    if not code then
        return false
    end

    local chunk = load(code, "@vrp/lib/utils.lua")

    if not chunk then
        return false
    end

    local ok, err = pcall(chunk)

    if not ok then
        FiveFly.Log("warn", FiveFly.T("log.vrp_utils_failed", tostring(err)))
    end

    return ok
end

local function ensurePolyfills()
    if type(table.maxn) ~= "function" then
        function table.maxn(t) ---@diagnostic disable-line: duplicate-set-field
            local max = 0

            for key in pairs(t) do
                local number = tonumber(key)

                if number and number > max then
                    max = number
                end
            end

            return max
        end
    end

    if type(async) ~= "function" then
        local function wait(self)
            local rets = Citizen.Await(self.p) or self.r
            return table.unpack(rets, 1, table.maxn(rets))
        end

        local function resolve(self, ...)
            self.r = { ... }
            self.p:resolve(self.r)
        end

        function async(func) ---@diagnostic disable-line: lowercase-global
            if func then
                Citizen.CreateThreadNow(func)
                return nil
            end

            return setmetatable({ wait = wait, p = promise.new() }, { __call = resolve })
        end
    end
end

local function ensureModuleLoader()
    if type(module) ~= "function" or type(async) ~= "function" or type(table.maxn) ~= "function" then
        loadVrpUtils()
    end

    ensurePolyfills()

    if type(module) == "function" then
        return
    end

    local modules = {}

    function module(rsc, path) ---@diagnostic disable-line: lowercase-global
        if path == nil then
            path = rsc
            rsc = "vrp"
        end

        local key = rsc .. path

        if modules[key] then
            return modules[key]
        end

        local code = LoadResourceFile(rsc, path .. ".lua")

        if not code then
            error(("resource file %s/%s.lua not found"):format(rsc, path))
        end

        local chunk, parseError = load(code, ("@%s/%s.lua"):format(rsc, path))

        if not chunk then
            error(parseError)
        end

        modules[key] = chunk()
        return modules[key]
    end
end

local function firstText(...)
    for i = 1, select("#", ...) do
        local value = FiveFly.Utils.Trim(tostring(select(i, ...) or ""))

        if value ~= "" and value ~= "nil" then
            return value
        end
    end

    return ""
end

local function getUserId(source)
    local userId = vRP.getUserId(source)
    return tonumber(userId)
end

FiveFly.Bridge.Register({
    name = "vrp",
    resource = "vrp",

    Init = function()
        ensureModuleLoader()
        local Proxy = module("vrp", "lib/Proxy")
        vRP = Proxy.getInterface("vRP")
        return vRP ~= nil
    end,

    GetIdentifier = function(source)
        local userId = getUserId(source)
        return userId and userId > 0 and ("vrp:" .. userId) or nil
    end,

    GetDisplayName = function(source)
        local userId = getUserId(source)

        if not userId or type(vRP.getUserIdentity) ~= "function" then
            return nil
        end

        local identity = vRP.getUserIdentity(userId)

        if type(identity) ~= "table" then
            return nil
        end

        -- Classic vRP: firstname = first name, name = surname. Brazilian forks: nome/sobrenome or name/lastname.
        if identity.firstname ~= nil then
            return FiveFly.Utils.Trim(firstText(identity.firstname) .. " " .. firstText(identity.name))
        end

        local firstName = firstText(identity.nome, identity.name, identity.firstName)
        local lastName = firstText(identity.sobrenome, identity.lastname, identity.lastName)

        return FiveFly.Utils.Trim(firstName .. " " .. lastName)
    end,

    HasPermission = function(source, permission)
        local userId = getUserId(source)
        return userId ~= nil and vRP.hasPermission(userId, permission) == true
    end
})

--- Registers FiveFly as a custom lb-phone app (only when Config.Phone.Enabled and lb-phone is running).
local RESOURCE_NAME <const> = GetCurrentResourceName()
local REGISTER_DELAY_MS <const> = 1000

local function getPhoneResource()
    return Config.Phone.Resource or "lb-phone"
end

local function registerApp()
    if not FiveFly.IsPhoneAvailable() then
        return
    end

    local phone = getPhoneResource()
    local app = {
        identifier = Config.Phone.Identifier,
        name = Config.Phone.Name,
        description = Config.Phone.Description or FiveFly.T("app.description"),
        developer = Config.Phone.Developer,
        resourceName = RESOURCE_NAME,
        defaultApp = Config.Phone.DefaultApp,
        size = Config.Phone.Size,
        fixBlur = true,
        ui = ("%s/ui/dist/index.html"):format(RESOURCE_NAME),
        icon = ("https://cfx-nui-%s/%s"):format(RESOURCE_NAME, Config.Phone.Icon or "ui/dist/icon.svg")
    }

    pcall(function()
        exports[phone]:RemoveCustomApp(Config.Phone.Identifier)
    end)

    local ok, added, errorMessage = pcall(function()
        return exports[phone]:AddCustomApp(app)
    end)

    if not ok or not added then
        FiveFly.Log("error", FiveFly.T("log.phone_register_failed", tostring(errorMessage or added)))
    end
end

CreateThread(function()
    if not Config.Phone.Enabled then
        return
    end

    -- Wait a limited time for lb-phone; onClientResourceStart covers a later start.
    for _ = 1, 60 do
        if GetResourceState(getPhoneResource()) == "started" then
            Wait(REGISTER_DELAY_MS)
            registerApp()
            return
        end

        Wait(1000)
    end
end)

AddEventHandler("onClientResourceStart", function(resourceName)
    if resourceName == getPhoneResource() then
        Wait(REGISTER_DELAY_MS)
        registerApp()
    end
end)

AddEventHandler("onClientResourceStop", function(resourceName)
    if resourceName ~= RESOURCE_NAME or not FiveFly.IsPhoneAvailable() then
        return
    end

    pcall(function()
        exports[getPhoneResource()]:RemoveCustomApp(Config.Phone.Identifier)
    end)
end)

--- Bridge to the hidden audio engine page (ui/engine), which plays the local track and nearby speakers.
FiveFly.AudioEngine = {
    ready = false,
    lastSession = nil,
    masterVolume = 100,
    progress = {
        videoId = nil,
        position = 0,
        duration = 0
    }
}

local clampVolume = FiveFly.Utils.ClampVolume

function FiveFly.AudioEngine.IsReady()
    return FiveFly.AudioEngine.ready == true
end

function FiveFly.AudioEngine.HasActiveSession()
    local session = FiveFly.AudioEngine.lastSession
    return type(session) == "table" and type(session.currentTrack) == "table"
end

local function sendEngineMessage(action, payload)
    SendNUIMessage({
        target = "audio-engine",
        action = action,
        payload = payload or {}
    })
end

local function getOutput()
    return tostring(FiveFly.Bluetooth.GetOutput() or "private")
end

function FiveFly.AudioEngine.PlaySession(session)
    if type(session) ~= "table" or type(session.currentTrack) ~= "table" then
        return false
    end

    FiveFly.AudioEngine.lastSession = session

    sendEngineMessage("engine.play", {
        track = session.currentTrack,
        playback = session.playback or {
            position = 0
        }
    })

    FiveFly.Sync.SetCurrentSession(session)

    return true
end

--- Updates the stored session (queue, modes, position) without restarting the current track.
function FiveFly.AudioEngine.UpdateSession(session)
    FiveFly.AudioEngine.lastSession = session
    FiveFly.Sync.SetCurrentSession(session)
end

function FiveFly.AudioEngine.Transport(action)
    local safeAction = tostring(action or "")

    if safeAction == "pause" then
        sendEngineMessage("engine.pause")
        return true
    end

    if safeAction == "resume" or safeAction == "play" then
        sendEngineMessage("engine.resume")
        return true
    end

    if safeAction == "stop" then
        sendEngineMessage("engine.stop")
        FiveFly.AudioEngine.lastSession = nil

        if FiveFly.Sync then
            FiveFly.Sync.ClearCurrentSession()
        end

        return true
    end

    return false
end

function FiveFly.AudioEngine.GetEffectiveVolume(value)
    return FiveFly.AudioEngine.GetExternalVolume(value)
end

function FiveFly.AudioEngine.GetLocalVolume(value)
    local safeValue = clampVolume(value)
    local output = getOutput()

    if output == "off" or output == "prop" or output == "vehicle" then
        return 0
    end

    if output == "private" then
        local localConfig = Config.LocalAudio or {}
        local multiplier = tonumber(localConfig.privateVolumeMultiplier) or 0.35
        return clampVolume(safeValue * multiplier)
    end

    return safeValue
end

function FiveFly.AudioEngine.GetExternalVolume(value)
    local safeValue = clampVolume(value)
    return safeValue
end

--- Re-applies the volume after an output change (the local volume depends on the output).
function FiveFly.AudioEngine.SetOutput()
    FiveFly.AudioEngine.SetVolume(FiveFly.Volume.value, FiveFly.Volume.muted)
end

function FiveFly.AudioEngine.SetVolume(value, muted)
    local localValue = FiveFly.AudioEngine.GetLocalVolume(value)
    local externalValue = FiveFly.AudioEngine.GetExternalVolume(value)

    sendEngineMessage("engine.volume", {
        value = localValue,
        externalValue = externalValue,
        muted = muted == true or localValue <= 0,
        externalMuted = muted == true or externalValue <= 0,
        output = getOutput()
    })
end

function FiveFly.AudioEngine.SetMasterVolume(value)
    local safeValue = clampVolume(value)
    FiveFly.AudioEngine.masterVolume = safeValue

    sendEngineMessage("engine.masterVolume", {
        value = safeValue
    })
end

function FiveFly.AudioEngine.Seek(position)
    local safePosition = tonumber(position) or 0
    safePosition = math.max(0, safePosition)

    sendEngineMessage("engine.seek", {
        position = safePosition
    })
end

function FiveFly.AudioEngine.AddExternalSource(sourceId, payload)
    sendEngineMessage("engine.external.add", {
        sourceId = tostring(sourceId),
        source = payload or {}
    })
end

function FiveFly.AudioEngine.UpdateExternalSource(sourceId, payload)
    sendEngineMessage("engine.external.update", {
        sourceId = tostring(sourceId),
        source = payload or {}
    })
end

function FiveFly.AudioEngine.SetExternalVolume(sourceId, volume)
    local safeVolume = tonumber(volume) or 0
    safeVolume = math.max(0, math.min(100, math.floor(safeVolume + 0.5)))

    sendEngineMessage("engine.external.volume", {
        sourceId = tostring(sourceId),
        volume = safeVolume
    })
end

function FiveFly.AudioEngine.RemoveExternalSource(sourceId)
    sendEngineMessage("engine.external.remove", {
        sourceId = tostring(sourceId)
    })
end

RegisterNUICallback("engine.ready", function(_, cb)
    FiveFly.AudioEngine.ready = true

    if FiveFly.Volume then
        FiveFly.AudioEngine.SetVolume(FiveFly.Volume.value, FiveFly.Volume.muted)
    end

    FiveFly.AudioEngine.SetMasterVolume(FiveFly.AudioEngine.masterVolume)

    if FiveFly.AudioEngine.lastSession then
        FiveFly.AudioEngine.PlaySession(FiveFly.AudioEngine.lastSession)
    end

    cb({
        ok = true
    })
end)

RegisterNUICallback("engine.progress", function(data, cb)
    FiveFly.AudioEngine.progress = {
        videoId = type(data) == "table" and data.videoId or nil,
        position = tonumber(type(data) == "table" and data.position or 0) or 0,
        duration = tonumber(type(data) == "table" and data.duration or 0) or 0
    }

    FiveFly.SendUiMessage("playback.progress", FiveFly.AudioEngine.progress)

    cb({
        ok = true
    })
end)

RegisterNUICallback("engine.ended", function(_, cb)
    FiveFly.Nui.HandleTrackEnded()
    cb({ ok = true })
end)

RegisterNUICallback("engine.error", function(data, cb)
    FiveFly.SendUiMessage("playback.error", type(data) == "table" and data or {
        error = "engine_error"
    })

    cb({ ok = true })
end)

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Master volume from an external mixer (Config.MasterVolume).
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function setMasterVolumeFromExport(first, second)
    -- Accepts (volume) or (self, volume) for mixers that call exports with a table first.
    FiveFly.AudioEngine.SetMasterVolume(type(first) == "table" and second or first)
end

exports("SetMasterVolume", setMasterVolumeFromExport)

for _, alias in ipairs(Config.MasterVolume and Config.MasterVolume.ExportAliases or {}) do
    exports(alias, setMasterVolumeFromExport)
end

local function readMixerVolume()
    local mixer = Config.MasterVolume or {}

    if not mixer.Resource or GetResourceState(mixer.Resource) ~= "started" then
        return
    end

    local ok, volume = pcall(function()
        return exports[mixer.Resource][mixer.Export or "GetVolume"](nil, GetCurrentResourceName())
    end)

    if ok and tonumber(volume) then
        FiveFly.AudioEngine.SetMasterVolume(volume)
    end
end

AddEventHandler("onClientResourceStart", function(resourceName)
    if Config.MasterVolume and resourceName == Config.MasterVolume.Resource then
        readMixerVolume()
    end
end)

CreateThread(function()
    Wait(1000)
    readMixerVolume()
end)

FiveFly.Bluetooth = {
    output = Config.Outputs.Default,
    lastAutoOffAt = 0
}

function FiveFly.Bluetooth.GetOutput()
    return FiveFly.Bluetooth.output
end

local function notifyAudioState(reason)
    FiveFly.SendUiMessage("audio.state", {
        output = FiveFly.Bluetooth.GetOutput(),
        reason = reason
    })
end

function FiveFly.Bluetooth.SetOutput(output)
    local safeOutput = tostring(output or Config.Outputs.Default)

    if not Config.Outputs.Allowed[safeOutput] then
        return false, "invalid_output"
    end

    if safeOutput == "vehicle" then
        if not FiveFly.Vehicle or not FiveFly.Vehicle.ConnectCurrent or not FiveFly.Vehicle.ConnectCurrent() then
            return false, "vehicle_missing"
        end
    elseif FiveFly.Vehicle and FiveFly.Vehicle.ClearConnected then
        FiveFly.Vehicle.ClearConnected()
    end

    FiveFly.Bluetooth.output = safeOutput

    if FiveFly.AudioEngine and FiveFly.AudioEngine.SetOutput then
        FiveFly.AudioEngine.SetOutput(safeOutput)
    end

    if safeOutput == "prop" then
        FiveFly.Prop.Ensure()
    elseif safeOutput ~= "prop" and FiveFly.Prop then
        FiveFly.Prop.Delete()
    end

    if FiveFly.Sync then
        FiveFly.Sync.UpdateCurrentSource(true)
    end

    notifyAudioState(nil)

    return true, nil
end

function FiveFly.Bluetooth.AutoOffOutput(reason)
    local output = FiveFly.Bluetooth.GetOutput()

    if output == "off" or output == "private" then
        return false
    end

    FiveFly.Bluetooth.lastAutoOffAt = GetGameTimer()
    FiveFly.Bluetooth.SetOutput("off")
    notifyAudioState(reason or "auto_off")

    return true
end

function FiveFly.Bluetooth.ValidateOutputTarget()
    local output = FiveFly.Bluetooth.GetOutput()

    if output == "off" or output == "private" then
        return true
    end

    if IsEntityDead(PlayerPedId()) then
        FiveFly.Bluetooth.AutoOffOutput("player_dead")
        return false
    end

    if output == "prop" then
        if not FiveFly.Prop or not FiveFly.Prop.Exists() then
            FiveFly.Bluetooth.AutoOffOutput("prop_missing")
            return false
        end

        return true
    end

    if output == "vehicle" then
        local target = FiveFly.Vehicle and FiveFly.Vehicle.GetOutputTarget and FiveFly.Vehicle.GetOutputTarget() or nil

        if not target or not target.sourceCoords then
            if FiveFly.StopPlayback then
                FiveFly.StopPlayback("vehicle_missing")
            end

            FiveFly.Bluetooth.AutoOffOutput("vehicle_missing")
            return false
        end

        if FiveFly.Vehicle.IsOwnerTooFar and FiveFly.Vehicle.IsOwnerTooFar() then
            if FiveFly.StopPlayback then
                FiveFly.StopPlayback("vehicle_owner_too_far")
            end

            FiveFly.Bluetooth.AutoOffOutput("vehicle_owner_too_far")
            return false
        end

        return true
    end

    return true
end

function FiveFly.Bluetooth.GetOutputTarget()
    local output = FiveFly.Bluetooth.GetOutput()

    if output == "off" or output == "private" then
        return {
            sourceType = output
        }
    end

    if output == "prop" then
        local entity, propNetId = FiveFly.Prop.Ensure()
        local propConfig = Config.Range and Config.Range.prop or {}

        if not entity then
            return nil
        end

        return {
            sourceType = "prop",
            sourceCoords = FiveFly.Prop.GetCoords(),
            propNetId = propNetId,
            range = tonumber(propConfig.range) or 16.0,
            volume = tonumber(propConfig.volume) or 78.0
        }
    end

    if output == "vehicle" then
        return FiveFly.Vehicle.GetOutputTarget()
    end

    return nil
end

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        local output = FiveFly.Bluetooth.GetOutput()

        if output == "prop" or output == "vehicle" then
            FiveFly.Bluetooth.ValidateOutputTarget()
            Wait(1000)
        else
            Wait(1500)
        end
    end
end)

FiveFly = FiveFly or {}

    value = 100,
    muted = false
}

--- Where the current playback was started from ("phone" or "panel"). Used by the phone item guard.
FiveFly.PlaybackOrigin = nil

local function getPhoneResource()
    return Config.Phone.Resource or "lb-phone"
end

function FiveFly.IsPhoneAvailable()
    return Config.Phone.Enabled == true and GetResourceState(getPhoneResource()) == "started"
end

--- Sends a state update to every UI: the lb-phone app (when available) and the panel/engine page.
function FiveFly.SendUiMessage(action, data)
    local message = { action = action, data = data or {} }

    if FiveFly.IsPhoneAvailable() then
        pcall(function()
            exports[getPhoneResource()]:SendCustomAppMessage(Config.Phone.Identifier, message)
        end)
    end

    SendNUIMessage({ target = "ui", action = action, data = message.data })
end

function FiveFly.GetEmptyPlaybackState()
    return {
        queue = {},
        currentTrack = nil,
        currentIndex = nil,
        status = "idle",
        playback = { position = 0, startedAt = 0, nonce = 0 }
    }
end

function FiveFly.StopPlayback(reason)
    FiveFly.AudioEngine.Transport("stop")
    FiveFly.PlaybackOrigin = nil

    FiveFly.Nui.RequestServer("playback.transport", { action = "stop", reason = tostring(reason or "stopped") }, function() end)
    FiveFly.SendUiMessage("playback.state", FiveFly.GetEmptyPlaybackState())
end

RegisterNetEvent("fivefly:client:forceStopPlayback", function(reason)
    if FiveFly.Bluetooth.GetOutput() ~= "off" then
        FiveFly.Bluetooth.SetOutput("off")
    end

    FiveFly.StopPlayback(reason or "force_stop")
end)

-- Phone item guard: stops music started from the phone when the player no longer has a phone.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function playerHasPhone()
    local ok, hasPhone = pcall(function()
        return exports[getPhoneResource()]:HasPhoneItem()
    end)

    return not ok or hasPhone == true
end

local function isGuardActive()
    return Config.Phone.StopWithoutPhoneItem == true
        and FiveFly.PlaybackOrigin == "phone"
        and FiveFly.IsPhoneAvailable()
        and FiveFly.AudioEngine.HasActiveSession()
end

local stopping = false

local function stopIfPhoneMissing()
    if stopping or not isGuardActive() or playerHasPhone() then
        return
    end

    stopping = true

    if FiveFly.Bluetooth.GetOutput() ~= "off" then
        FiveFly.Bluetooth.SetOutput("off")
    end

    FiveFly.StopPlayback("missing_phone")

    SetTimeout(2500, function()
        stopping = false
    end)
end

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        if isGuardActive() then
            stopIfPhoneMissing()
            Wait(1000)
        else
            Wait(2500)
        end
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent("lb-phone:itemRemoved", stopIfPhoneMissing)

--- NUI callbacks shared by the phone app and the panel. Most actions are forwarded to the server as-is;
--- playback actions also drive the local audio engine with the session returned by the server.
FiveFly.Nui = {}

local Nui = FiveFly.Nui
local pendingRequests = {}
local requestCounter = 0
local REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS <const> = 10000

function Nui.Ok(data)
    return { ok = true, data = data }
end

function Nui.Fail(errorCode)
    return { ok = false, error = tostring(errorCode or "unknown_error") }
end

--- Sends an action to the server and calls `cb` with the response envelope (or a timeout error).
function Nui.RequestServer(action, payload, cb)
    requestCounter = requestCounter + 1

    local requestId = ("%d:%d"):format(GetGameTimer(), requestCounter)
    pendingRequests[requestId] = cb

    TriggerServerEvent("fivefly:server:request", requestId, action, payload or {})

    SetTimeout(REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS, function()
        local pending = pendingRequests[requestId]

        if pending then
            pendingRequests[requestId] = nil
            pending(Nui.Fail("server_timeout"))
        end
    end)
end

RegisterNetEvent("fivefly:client:response", function(requestId, response)
    local key = tostring(requestId or "")
    local cb = pendingRequests[key]

    if not cb then
        return
    end

    pendingRequests[key] = nil
    cb(type(response) == "table" and response or Nui.Fail("invalid_server_response"))
end)

--- Strips client-only fields before forwarding and remembers which UI started playback.
local function readPayload(data)
    local payload = type(data) == "table" and data or {}
    local origin = payload._origin
    payload._origin = nil
    return payload, (origin == "panel" or origin == "phone") and origin or nil
end

local function getAudioState()
    return {
        output = FiveFly.Bluetooth.GetOutput(),
        volume = FiveFly.Volume.value,
        muted = FiveFly.Volume.muted
    }
end

-- Actions forwarded to the server without client-side handling.
local FORWARDED_ACTIONS <const> = {
    "playback.state.get",
    "music.search",
    "music.stations.get",
    "music.recommendations.get",
    "social.search",
    "social.profile.get",
    "social.profile.update",
    "social.follow.toggle",
    "library.favorites.get",
    "library.favorites.toggle",
    "library.history.get",
    "library.history.clear",
    "library.smart-playlists.get",
    "library.playlists.get",
    "library.playlists.create",
    "library.playlists.import",
    "library.playlists.cover.set",
    "library.playlists.visibility.set",
    "library.playlists.delete",
    "library.playlists.tracks.get",
    "library.playlists.tracks.add",
    "library.playlists.tracks.remove",
    "playback.sessions.get",
    "playback.friends.get"
}

-- Successful mutations are announced so the other UI (phone or panel) reloads its data.
local LIBRARY_MUTATIONS <const> = {
    ["social.profile.update"] = true,
    ["social.follow.toggle"] = true,
    ["library.favorites.toggle"] = true,
    ["library.history.clear"] = true,
    ["library.playlists.create"] = true,
    ["library.playlists.import"] = true,
    ["library.playlists.cover.set"] = true,
    ["library.playlists.visibility.set"] = true,
    ["library.playlists.delete"] = true,
    ["library.playlists.tracks.add"] = true,
    ["library.playlists.tracks.remove"] = true
}

for _, action in ipairs(FORWARDED_ACTIONS) do
    RegisterNUICallback(action, function(data, cb)
        local payload, origin = readPayload(data)

        Nui.RequestServer(action, payload, function(response)
            if response.ok and LIBRARY_MUTATIONS[action] then
                FiveFly.SendUiMessage("library.changed", { origin = origin, action = action })
            end

            cb(response)
        end)
    end)
end

RegisterNUICallback("app.ready", function(_, cb)
    cb(Nui.Ok({
        identifier = Config.Phone.Identifier,
        name = Config.Phone.Name,
        locale = Config.Locale,
        phoneAvailable = FiveFly.IsPhoneAvailable(),
        panelEnabled = Config.Panel.Enabled == true
    }))
end)

RegisterNUICallback("app.get-initial-state", function(data, cb)
    local payload = readPayload(data)

    Nui.RequestServer("app.get-initial-state", payload, function(response)
        if response.ok and type(response.data) == "table" then
            response.data.audio = getAudioState()
        end

        cb(response)
    end)
end)

--- Plays the session returned by the server and broadcasts it to the other UI.
local function applySession(session, origin)
    if type(session) ~= "table" then
        return
    end

    if session.currentTrack then
        FiveFly.AudioEngine.PlaySession(session)

        if origin then
            FiveFly.PlaybackOrigin = origin
        end
    else
        FiveFly.AudioEngine.Transport("stop")
        FiveFly.PlaybackOrigin = nil
    end

    FiveFly.SendUiMessage("playback.state", session)
end

--- Keeps the engine's session in sync without restarting the current track.
local function updateSession(session)
    if type(session) == "table" and session.currentTrack then
        FiveFly.AudioEngine.UpdateSession(session)
    end

    FiveFly.SendUiMessage("playback.state", session)
end

for _, action in ipairs({ "playback.play", "playback.sessions.join" }) do
    RegisterNUICallback(action, function(data, cb)
        local payload, origin = readPayload(data)

        Nui.RequestServer(action, payload, function(response)
            if response.ok and response.data then
                applySession(response.data.session, origin)
            end

            cb(response)
        end)
    end)
end

RegisterNUICallback("playback.transport", function(data, cb)
    local payload = readPayload(data)
    local action = payload.action

    Nui.RequestServer("playback.transport", payload, function(response)
        if response.ok and response.data then
            local session = response.data.session

            if action == "next" or action == "prev" or action == "stop" then
                applySession(session, nil)
            else
                FiveFly.AudioEngine.Transport(action)
                updateSession(session)
            end
        end

        cb(response)
    end)
end)

for _, action in ipairs({ "playback.queue.set", "playback.mode.set" }) do
    RegisterNUICallback(action, function(data, cb)
        Nui.RequestServer(action, readPayload(data), function(response)
            if response.ok and response.data then
                updateSession(response.data.session)
            end

            cb(response)
        end)
    end)
end

RegisterNUICallback("playback.seek", function(data, cb)
    local payload = readPayload(data)

    Nui.RequestServer("playback.seek", payload, function(response)
        if response.ok and response.data then
            FiveFly.AudioEngine.Seek(payload.position)
            updateSession(response.data.session)
        end

        cb(response)
    end)
end)

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Local audio settings (never reach the server).
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

RegisterNUICallback("audio.output.get", function(_, cb)
    cb(Nui.Ok({ output = FiveFly.Bluetooth.GetOutput() }))
end)

RegisterNUICallback("audio.output.set", function(data, cb)
    local output = type(data) == "table" and tostring(data.output or "") or ""
    local success, errorCode = FiveFly.Bluetooth.SetOutput(output)

    if not success then
        cb(Nui.Fail(errorCode))
        return
    end

    cb(Nui.Ok({ output = output }))
end)

local function applyVolume()
    FiveFly.AudioEngine.SetVolume(FiveFly.Volume.value, FiveFly.Volume.muted)
    FiveFly.Sync.UpdateCurrentSource(true)
    FiveFly.SendUiMessage("audio.state", getAudioState())
end

RegisterNUICallback("audio.volume.set", function(data, cb)
    FiveFly.Volume.value = FiveFly.Utils.ClampVolume(type(data) == "table" and data.value or 100)
    applyVolume()
    cb(Nui.Ok({ value = FiveFly.Volume.value }))
end)

RegisterNUICallback("audio.mute.set", function(data, cb)
    FiveFly.Volume.muted = type(data) == "table" and data.muted == true
    applyVolume()
    cb(Nui.Ok({ muted = FiveFly.Volume.muted }))
end)

--- Auto-advance when the engine reports the end of a track.
function Nui.HandleTrackEnded()
    Nui.RequestServer("playback.transport", { action = "next", reason = "ended" }, function(response)
        if response.ok and response.data then
            applySession(response.data.session, nil)
        end
    end)
end

--- Desktop panel: a larger UI rendered in the same page as the audio engine (ui/engine/index.html).
FiveFly.Panel = {
    open = false
}

local Panel = FiveFly.Panel

local function setOpen(open)
    if Panel.open == open then
        return
    end

    Panel.open = open
    SetNuiFocus(open, open)
    SendNUIMessage({ target = "panel", action = open and "open" or "close" })
end

function Panel.Open()
    if not Config.Panel.Enabled or Panel.open then
        return
    end

    local canOpen = Config.Panel.CanOpen

    if type(canOpen) == "function" then
        local ok, allowed = pcall(canOpen)

        if ok and allowed == false then
            return
        end
    end

    setOpen(true)
end

function Panel.Close()
    setOpen(false)
end

function Panel.Toggle()
    if Panel.open then
        Panel.Close()
    else
        Panel.Open()
    end
end

RegisterNUICallback("panel.close", function(_, cb)
    Panel.Close()
    cb({ ok = true })
end)

if Config.Panel.Enabled then
    local command = tostring(Config.Panel.Command or "fivefly")

    RegisterCommand(command, Panel.Toggle, false)

    if Config.Panel.DefaultKey ~= nil then
        RegisterKeyMapping(command, Config.Panel.KeyDescription or FiveFly.T("panel.key_description", Config.Phone.Name or "FiveFly"), "keyboard", Config.Panel.DefaultKey)
    end

    -- Close when the player dies while the panel is open.
    CreateThread(function()
        while true do
            if Panel.open then
                if IsEntityDead(PlayerPedId()) then
                    Panel.Close()
                end

                Wait(500)
            else
                Wait(1500)
            end
        end
    end)
end

AddEventHandler("onResourceStop", function(resourceName)
    if resourceName == GetCurrentResourceName() and Panel.open then
        SetNuiFocus(false, false)
    end
end)

FiveFly.Prop = {
    entity = nil,
    netId = nil
}

function FiveFly.Prop.GetModel()
    return Config.Prop.Model
end

local function loadModel(modelName)
    local modelHash = type(modelName) == "string" and GetHashKey(modelName) or modelName

    if not IsModelInCdimage(modelHash) or not IsModelValid(modelHash) then
        return nil
    end

    RequestModel(modelHash)

    local timeoutAt = GetGameTimer() + 8000

    while not HasModelLoaded(modelHash) do
        Wait(10)

        if GetGameTimer() > timeoutAt then
            return nil
        end
    end

    return modelHash
end

local function attachToPlayer(entity)
    local ped = PlayerPedId()
    local attach = Config.Prop.Attach

    AttachEntityToEntity(
        entity,
        ped,
        GetPedBoneIndex(ped, Config.Prop.Bone),
        attach.x,
        attach.y,
        attach.z,
        attach.rx,
        attach.ry,
        attach.rz,
        true,
        true,
        false,
        true,
        1,
        true
    )
end

function FiveFly.Prop.Exists()
    return FiveFly.Prop.entity and DoesEntityExist(FiveFly.Prop.entity)
end

function FiveFly.Prop.Ensure()
    if FiveFly.Prop.Exists() then
        if not IsEntityAttached(FiveFly.Prop.entity) then
            attachToPlayer(FiveFly.Prop.entity)
        end

        return FiveFly.Prop.entity, FiveFly.Prop.netId
    end

    local modelHash = loadModel(Config.Prop.Model)

    if not modelHash then
        return nil, nil
    end

    local coords = GetEntityCoords(PlayerPedId())
    local entity = CreateObject(modelHash, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, true, true, false)

    if not entity or entity == 0 then
        return nil, nil
    end

    SetEntityAsMissionEntity(entity, true, true)
    attachToPlayer(entity)

    FiveFly.Prop.entity = entity
    FiveFly.Prop.netId = NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(entity)

    return FiveFly.Prop.entity, FiveFly.Prop.netId
end

function FiveFly.Prop.GetCoords()
    if not FiveFly.Prop.Exists() then
        return nil
    end

    return GetEntityCoords(FiveFly.Prop.entity)
end

function FiveFly.Prop.Delete()
    if FiveFly.Prop.Exists() then
        DeleteEntity(FiveFly.Prop.entity)
    end

    FiveFly.Prop.entity = nil
    FiveFly.Prop.netId = nil
end

AddEventHandler("onClientResourceStop", function(resourceName)
    if resourceName ~= GetCurrentResourceName() then
        return
    end

    FiveFly.Prop.Delete()
end)

FiveFly.Sync = {
    activeSession = nil,
    lastUpdateAt = 0,
    lastCoords = nil,
    active = false,
    externalVolumeAction = "engine.external.volume",
    externalSources = {}
}

function FiveFly.Sync.IsActive()
    return FiveFly.Sync.active == true
end

local function distanceBetween(a, b)
    if not a or not b then
        return 999999.0
    end

    return #(a - b)
end

local function spatialDistance(listenerCoords, sourceCoords, attenuation)
    if not listenerCoords or not sourceCoords then
        return 999999.0
    end

    local verticalScale = tonumber(attenuation and attenuation.verticalScale) or 1.0
    local dx = (listenerCoords.x or 0.0) - (sourceCoords.x or 0.0)
    local dy = (listenerCoords.y or 0.0) - (sourceCoords.y or 0.0)
    local dz = ((listenerCoords.z or 0.0) - (sourceCoords.z or 0.0)) * verticalScale

    return math.sqrt((dx * dx) + (dy * dy) + (dz * dz))
end

local function clamp(value, minValue, maxValue)
    local safeValue = tonumber(value) or minValue
    return math.max(minValue, math.min(maxValue, safeValue))
end

local function applyOutputProfileVolume(sourceVolume, outputVolume)
    local safeSourceVolume = clamp(sourceVolume, 0, 100)
    local safeOutputVolume = clamp(outputVolume or 100, 0, 100)

    return clamp((safeSourceVolume * safeOutputVolume) / 100, 0, 100)
end

local function toVector3(coords)
    if not coords then
        return nil
    end

    if type(coords) == "vector3" then
        return coords
    end

    if type(coords) == "table" and coords.x and coords.y and coords.z then
        return vector3(tonumber(coords.x) or 0.0, tonumber(coords.y) or 0.0, tonumber(coords.z) or 0.0)
    end

    return nil
end

local function buildSourcePayload(force)
    local session = FiveFly.Sync.activeSession

    if type(session) ~= "table" or type(session.currentTrack) ~= "table" then
        return nil
    end

    if FiveFly.Bluetooth.ValidateOutputTarget and not FiveFly.Bluetooth.ValidateOutputTarget() then
        return {
            stop = true
        }
    end

    local target = FiveFly.Bluetooth.GetOutputTarget()

    if not target or target.sourceType == "private" or target.sourceType == "off" then
        return {
            stop = true
        }
    end

    if not target.sourceCoords then
        return nil
    end

    local now = GetGameTimer()
    local moved = distanceBetween(target.sourceCoords, FiveFly.Sync.lastCoords) >= Config.Sync.PositionThreshold

    if not force and not moved and now - FiveFly.Sync.lastUpdateAt < Config.Sync.PositionIntervalMs then
        return nil
    end

    FiveFly.Sync.lastUpdateAt = now
    FiveFly.Sync.lastCoords = target.sourceCoords

    local sourceVolume = FiveFly.Volume and FiveFly.Volume.value or 100

    if FiveFly.Volume and FiveFly.Volume.muted then
        sourceVolume = 0
    elseif FiveFly.AudioEngine and FiveFly.AudioEngine.GetEffectiveVolume then
        sourceVolume = FiveFly.AudioEngine.GetEffectiveVolume(sourceVolume)
    end

    sourceVolume = applyOutputProfileVolume(sourceVolume, target.volume)

    local progress = FiveFly.AudioEngine and FiveFly.AudioEngine.progress or {}
    local playback = session.playback or {}
    local progressVideoId = tostring(progress.videoId or "")
    local trackVideoId = tostring(session.currentTrack.videoId or "")
    local position = tonumber(playback.position) or 0

    if progressVideoId ~= "" and progressVideoId == trackVideoId then
        position = tonumber(progress.position) or position
    end

    return {
        track = session.currentTrack,
        status = session.status or "online",
        playback = {
            position = math.max(0, position),
            startedAt = tonumber(playback.startedAt) or 0,
            nonce = tonumber(playback.nonce) or 0
        },
        sourceType = target.sourceType,
        sourceCoords = target.sourceCoords,
        propNetId = target.propNetId,
        vehicleNetId = target.vehicleNetId,
        range = tonumber(target.range),
        volume = sourceVolume,
        profile = target.profile,
        vehicleClass = target.vehicleClass,
        soundSystem = target.soundSystem == true
    }
end

function FiveFly.Sync.SetCurrentSession(session)
    FiveFly.Sync.activeSession = session
    FiveFly.Sync.active = type(session) == "table" and type(session.currentTrack) == "table"
    FiveFly.Sync.UpdateCurrentSource(true)
end

function FiveFly.Sync.ClearCurrentSession()
    FiveFly.Sync.activeSession = nil
    FiveFly.Sync.active = false
    TriggerServerEvent("fivefly:server:stopSource")
end

function FiveFly.Sync.UpdateCurrentSource(force)
    local payload = buildSourcePayload(force == true)

    if not payload then
        return
    end

    if payload.stop then
        TriggerServerEvent("fivefly:server:stopSource")
        return
    end

    TriggerServerEvent("fivefly:server:updateSource", payload)
end

function FiveFly.Sync.CalculateExternalVolume(sourceInfo)
    if type(sourceInfo) ~= "table" then
        return 0
    end

    local sourceCoords = toVector3(sourceInfo.sourceCoords)

    if not sourceCoords then
        return 0
    end

    local attenuation = Config.Attenuation or {}
    local distance = spatialDistance(GetEntityCoords(PlayerPedId()), sourceCoords, attenuation)

    return FiveFly.Utils.AttenuatedVolume(distance, sourceInfo.range, sourceInfo.volume, attenuation)
end

function FiveFly.Sync.UpdateExternalVolumes()
    if not FiveFly.AudioEngine then
        return
    end

    local attenuation = Config.Attenuation or {}
    local smoothing = clamp(attenuation.smoothingFactor or 0.15, 0.0, 1.0)

    for sourceId, sourceInfo in pairs(FiveFly.Sync.externalSources) do
        local targetVolume = FiveFly.Sync.CalculateExternalVolume(sourceInfo)
        local currentVolume = tonumber(sourceInfo.currentVolume)

        if not currentVolume then
            currentVolume = targetVolume
        else
            currentVolume = currentVolume + ((targetVolume - currentVolume) * smoothing)
        end

        if currentVolume < 0.5 then
            currentVolume = 0
        end

        sourceInfo.currentVolume = currentVolume

        FiveFly.AudioEngine.SetExternalVolume(sourceId, currentVolume)
    end
end

RegisterNetEvent("fivefly:client:sourceAdded", function(sourceId, payload)
    if not FiveFly.AudioEngine or type(payload) ~= "table" then
        return
    end

    FiveFly.Sync.externalSources[sourceId] = payload
    FiveFly.AudioEngine.AddExternalSource(sourceId, payload)
    FiveFly.Sync.UpdateExternalVolumes()
end)

RegisterNetEvent("fivefly:client:sourceUpdated", function(sourceId, payload)
    if not FiveFly.AudioEngine or type(payload) ~= "table" then
        return
    end

    local previous = FiveFly.Sync.externalSources[sourceId] or {}
    payload.currentVolume = previous.currentVolume
    FiveFly.Sync.externalSources[sourceId] = payload
    FiveFly.AudioEngine.UpdateExternalSource(sourceId, payload)
    FiveFly.Sync.UpdateExternalVolumes()
end)

RegisterNetEvent("fivefly:client:sourceRemoved", function(sourceId)
    if not FiveFly.AudioEngine then
        return
    end

    FiveFly.Sync.externalSources[sourceId] = nil
    FiveFly.AudioEngine.RemoveExternalSource(sourceId)
end)

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        if FiveFly.Sync.IsActive() then
            FiveFly.Sync.UpdateCurrentSource(false)
            Wait(Config.Sync.PositionIntervalMs)
        else
            Wait(1000)
        end
    end
end)

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        local hasExternalSources = next(FiveFly.Sync.externalSources) ~= nil

        if hasExternalSources then
            FiveFly.Sync.UpdateExternalVolumes()
            Wait(Config.Sync.VolumeIntervalMs)
        else
            Wait(1000)
        end
    end
end)

FiveFly.Vehicle = {
    lastVehicle = nil,
    connectedVehicle = nil,
    connectedVehicleNetId = nil
}

local function isVehicleValid(vehicle)
    return vehicle and vehicle ~= 0 and DoesEntityExist(vehicle)
end

local function tableHasValue(values, value)
    if type(values) ~= "table" or value == nil then
        return false
    end

    local stringValue = tostring(value):lower()

    if values[value] == true or values[stringValue] == true then
        return true
    end

    for _, entry in pairs(values) do
        if tostring(entry):lower() == stringValue then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

local function modelMatches(models, model, displayName)
    if type(models) ~= "table" or not model then
        return false
    end

    local safeDisplayName = tostring(displayName or ""):lower()

    if models[model] == true or models[tostring(model)] == true or models[safeDisplayName] == true then
        return true
    end

    for key, entry in pairs(models) do
        local candidate = entry == true and key or entry
        local safeCandidate = tostring(candidate or ""):lower()

        if safeCandidate ~= "" then
            if safeCandidate == safeDisplayName then
                return true
            end

            if GetHashKey(safeCandidate) == model then
                return true
            end
        end
    end

    return false
end

local function displayNameMatches(patterns, displayName)
    if type(patterns) ~= "table" or not displayName then
        return false
    end

    local safeDisplayName = tostring(displayName):lower()

    for _, pattern in pairs(patterns) do
        local safePattern = tostring(pattern or ""):lower()

        if safePattern ~= "" and safeDisplayName:find(safePattern, 1, true) then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

local function getAudioProfile(vehicle)
    local vehicleConfig = Config.Range and Config.Range.vehicle or {}
    local defaultConfig = type(vehicleConfig) == "table" and vehicleConfig.default or {}
    local classProfiles = type(vehicleConfig) == "table" and vehicleConfig.classProfiles or {}
    local soundConfig = type(vehicleConfig) == "table" and vehicleConfig.soundSystem or nil
    local model = GetEntityModel(vehicle)
    local displayName = GetDisplayNameFromVehicleModel(model)
    local vehicleClass = GetVehicleClass(vehicle)
    local isSoundSystem = false

    if type(soundConfig) == "table" then
        isSoundSystem = modelMatches(soundConfig.models, model, displayName)
            or tableHasValue(soundConfig.classes, vehicleClass)
            or displayNameMatches(soundConfig.namePatterns, displayName)
    end

    local classProfile = type(classProfiles) == "table" and (classProfiles[vehicleClass] or classProfiles[tostring(vehicleClass)]) or nil
    local profile = defaultConfig
    local profileId = "default"

    if isSoundSystem then
        profile = soundConfig
        profileId = "soundSystem"
    elseif type(classProfile) == "table" then
        profile = classProfile
        profileId = "class:" .. tostring(vehicleClass)
    end

    return {
        range = tonumber(profile and profile.range) or 24.0,
        volume = tonumber(profile and profile.volume) or 82.0,
        profile = profileId,
        soundSystem = isSoundSystem,
        vehicleModel = model,
        vehicleClass = vehicleClass,
        vehicleDisplayName = displayName
    }
end

local function connectAudioVehicle(vehicle)
    -- Native trailers are separate vehicles: only sound-system trailers replace the car.
    local attached, trailer = GetVehicleTrailerVehicle(vehicle)

    if attached and isVehicleValid(trailer) and getAudioProfile(trailer).soundSystem then
        vehicle = trailer
    end

    -- Keep the selected emitter after detaching, until disconnect or entity removal.
    FiveFly.Vehicle.connectedVehicle = vehicle
    FiveFly.Vehicle.connectedVehicleNetId = NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(vehicle)

    return vehicle
end

function FiveFly.Vehicle.GetCurrent()
    local ped = PlayerPedId()
    local vehicle = GetVehiclePedIsIn(ped, false)

    if isVehicleValid(vehicle) then
        FiveFly.Vehicle.lastVehicle = vehicle
        return vehicle
    end

    return nil
end

function FiveFly.Vehicle.GetLast()
    if isVehicleValid(FiveFly.Vehicle.lastVehicle) then
        return FiveFly.Vehicle.lastVehicle
    end

    return nil
end

function FiveFly.Vehicle.ConnectCurrent()
    local vehicle = FiveFly.Vehicle.GetCurrent() or FiveFly.Vehicle.GetLast()

    if not isVehicleValid(vehicle) then
        return false
    end

    connectAudioVehicle(vehicle)
    FiveFly.Vehicle.lastVehicle = vehicle

    return true
end

function FiveFly.Vehicle.ClearConnected()
    FiveFly.Vehicle.connectedVehicle = nil
    FiveFly.Vehicle.connectedVehicleNetId = nil
end

function FiveFly.Vehicle.GetConnected()
    if isVehicleValid(FiveFly.Vehicle.connectedVehicle) then
        return connectAudioVehicle(FiveFly.Vehicle.connectedVehicle)
    end

    local netId = tonumber(FiveFly.Vehicle.connectedVehicleNetId or 0)

    if netId > 0 then
        local vehicle = NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(netId)

        if isVehicleValid(vehicle) then
            return connectAudioVehicle(vehicle)
        end
    end

    FiveFly.Vehicle.ClearConnected()
    return nil
end

function FiveFly.Vehicle.GetOwnerDistance()
    local vehicle = FiveFly.Vehicle.GetConnected()

    if not vehicle then
        return nil
    end

    return #(GetEntityCoords(PlayerPedId()) - GetEntityCoords(vehicle))
end

function FiveFly.Vehicle.IsOwnerTooFar()
    local vehicleConfig = Config.Range and Config.Range.vehicle or {}
    local maxDistance = tonumber(vehicleConfig.ownerMaxDistance) or 80.0
    local distance = FiveFly.Vehicle.GetOwnerDistance()

    return distance ~= nil and distance > maxDistance
end

function FiveFly.Vehicle.GetOutputTarget()
    local vehicle = FiveFly.Vehicle.GetConnected()

    if not vehicle then
        return nil
    end

    local profile = getAudioProfile(vehicle)

    return {
        sourceType = "vehicle",
        sourceCoords = GetEntityCoords(vehicle),
        vehicleNetId = NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(vehicle),
        range = profile.range,
        volume = profile.volume,
        profile = profile.profile,
        soundSystem = profile.soundSystem,
        vehicleModel = profile.vehicleModel,
        vehicleClass = profile.vehicleClass,
        vehicleDisplayName = profile.vehicleDisplayName
    }
end

local Actions = FiveFly.Actions
local Utils = FiveFly.Utils
local Tracks = FiveFly.Repo.Tracks
local Playlists = FiveFly.Repo.Playlists

local READ_MS <const> = Config.RateLimits.LibraryReadMs
local WRITE_MS <const> = Config.RateLimits.LibraryWriteMs

Actions.Register("library.favorites.get", {
    handler = function(ctx)
        return { favorites = Tracks.GetFavorites(ctx.userId) }
    end
})

Actions.Register("library.favorites.toggle", {
    rateLimit = WRITE_MS,
    handler = function(ctx, payload)
        local track = Utils.NormalizeTrack(payload.track)

        if not track then
            return nil, "invalid_track"
        end

        return { favorite = Tracks.ToggleFavorite(ctx.userId, track), track = track }
    end
})

Actions.Register("library.history.get", {
    handler = function(ctx)
        return { history = Tracks.GetHistory(ctx.userId, 50) }
    end
})

Actions.Register("library.history.clear", {
    rateLimit = WRITE_MS,
    handler = function(ctx)
        Tracks.ClearHistory(ctx.userId)
        return { cleared = true }
    end
})

Actions.Register("library.smart-playlists.get", {
    rateLimit = READ_MS,
    handler = function(ctx)
        return { playlists = FiveFly.Library.GetSmartPlaylists(ctx.userId) }
    end
})

Actions.Register("library.playlists.get", {
    handler = function(ctx)
        return { playlists = Playlists.GetByUser(ctx.userId) }
    end
})

Actions.Register("library.playlists.create", {
    rateLimit = WRITE_MS,
    handler = function(ctx, payload)
        local playlist, err = Playlists.Create(ctx.userId, payload.name)
        return playlist and { playlist = playlist } or nil, err
    end
})

Actions.Register("library.playlists.import", {
    rateLimit = WRITE_MS,
    handler = function(ctx, payload)
        local playlist, err = Playlists.ImportByCode(ctx.userId, payload.shareCode)
        return playlist and { playlist = playlist } or nil, err
    end
})

Actions.Register("library.playlists.cover.set", {
    rateLimit = WRITE_MS,
    handler = function(ctx, payload)
        local cover, mediaError = FiveFly.Media.ResolveImageUrl(payload.cover)

        if cover == nil then
            return nil, mediaError
        end

        local updated, err = Playlists.SetCover(ctx.userId, payload.playlistId, cover)
        return updated and { updated = true, cover = cover } or nil, err
    end
})

Actions.Register("library.playlists.visibility.set", {
    rateLimit = WRITE_MS,
    handler = function(ctx, payload)
        local visibility, err = Playlists.SetVisibility(ctx.userId, payload.playlistId, payload.visibility)
        return visibility and { visibility = visibility } or nil, err
    end
})

Actions.Register("library.playlists.delete", {
    rateLimit = WRITE_MS,
    handler = function(ctx, payload)
        local deleted, err = Playlists.Delete(ctx.userId, payload.playlistId)
        return deleted and { deleted = true } or nil, err
    end
})

Actions.Register("library.playlists.tracks.get", {
    handler = function(ctx, payload)
        local tracks, err = Playlists.GetTracks(ctx.userId, payload.playlistId)
        return tracks and { tracks = tracks } or nil, err
    end
})

Actions.Register("library.playlists.tracks.add", {
    rateLimit = WRITE_MS,
    handler = function(ctx, payload)
        local track = Utils.NormalizeTrack(payload.track)

        if not track then

local Actions = FiveFly.Actions
local Library = FiveFly.Library
local Repo = FiveFly.Repo

-- Heaviest read (about ten queries): a short limit blocks spam without breaking reloads after mutations.
Actions.Register("app.get-initial-state", {
    rateLimit = 300,
    handler = function(ctx)
        local profile = Library.GetPlayerProfile(ctx.source, ctx.userId)

        return {
            locale = Config.Locale,
            appName = Config.Phone.Name or "FiveFly",
            profile = profile,
            playback = FiveFly.Sessions.GetState(ctx.source),
            library = {
                favorites = Repo.Tracks.GetFavorites(ctx.userId),
                playlists = Repo.Playlists.GetByUser(ctx.userId),
                history = Repo.Tracks.GetHistory(ctx.userId, 50),
                stations = Library.GetStations(),
                sharedSessions = FiveFly.Sessions.GetSharedSessions(ctx.source),
                friendsListening = FiveFly.Sessions.GetFriendsListening(ctx.source, ctx.userId),
                recommendations = Library.GetRecommendations(ctx.userId),
                smartPlaylists = Library.GetSmartPlaylists(ctx.userId),
                followingProfiles = profile.followingProfiles or {}
            }
        }
    end
})

Actions.Register("music.search", {
    rateLimit = Config.Search.CooldownMs,
    handler = function(_, payload)
        local success, results, searchError = FiveFly.Search.SearchTracks(payload.query)

        if not success then
            return nil, searchError
        end

        return { results = results }
    end
})

Actions.Register("music.stations.get", {
    handler = function()
        return { stations = Library.GetStations() }
    end
})

Actions.Register("music.recommendations.get", {
    rateLimit = Config.RateLimits.LibraryReadMs,
    handler = function(ctx)
        return { recommendations = Library.GetRecommendations(ctx.userId) }
    end
})

local Actions = FiveFly.Actions
local Library = FiveFly.Library

local WRITE_MS <const> = Config.RateLimits.LibraryWriteMs

Actions.Register("social.search", {
    handler = function(ctx, payload)
        return Library.SearchSocial(ctx.userId, payload.query)
    end
})

Actions.Register("social.profile.get", {
    handler = function(ctx, payload)
        local profile, err = Library.GetSocialProfile(ctx.userId, payload.userId)
        return profile and { profile = profile } or nil, err
    end
})

Actions.Register("social.profile.update", {
    rateLimit = WRITE_MS,
    handler = function(ctx, payload)
        local profile, err = Library.UpdateProfile(ctx.source, ctx.userId, payload)
        return profile and { profile = profile } or nil, err
    end
})

Actions.Register("social.follow.toggle", {
    rateLimit = WRITE_MS,
    handler = function(ctx, payload)
        local following, err = FiveFly.Repo.Profiles.ToggleFollow(ctx.userId, payload.userId)

        if following == nil then
            return nil, err
        end

        return { following = following }
    end
})

---@field source integer
---@field userId integer

---@class ActionDefinition
---@field rateLimit? integer cooldown in ms per player
---@field handler fun(ctx: ActionContext, payload: table): any, string|nil returns data, or nil plus an error code

---@param name string
---@param definition ActionDefinition
function Actions.Register(name, definition)
    Actions.registry[name] = definition
end

local function ok(data)
    return { ok = true, data = data }
end

local function fail(errorCode)
    return { ok = false, error = tostring(errorCode or "unknown_error") }
end

---@return table response
function Actions.Dispatch(source, action, payload)
    local definition = Actions.registry[action]

    if not definition then
        return fail("unknown_action")
    end

    if not FiveFly.Database.ready then
        return fail("database_not_ready")
    end

    if not FiveFly.Permissions.CanUse(source) then
        return fail("permission_denied")
    end

    if definition.rateLimit and not FiveFly.RateLimit.Allow(source, action, definition.rateLimit) then
        return fail("rate_limited")
    end

    local userId = FiveFly.Identity.GetUserId(source)

    if not userId then
        return fail("identity_unavailable")
    end

    local success, data, errorCode = pcall(definition.handler, { source = source, userId = userId }, payload)

    if not success then
        FiveFly.Log("error", FiveFly.T("log.action_failed", action, tostring(data)))
        return fail("internal_error")
    end

    if errorCode then
        return fail(errorCode)
    end

    return ok(data)
end

RegisterNetEvent("fivefly:server:request", function(requestId, action, payload)
    local source = source
    local safeRequestId = tostring(requestId or ""):sub(1, 64)

    if safeRequestId == "" then
        return
    end

    local response = Actions.Dispatch(source, tostring(action or ""), type(payload) == "table" and payload or {})
    TriggerClientEvent("fivefly:client:response", source, safeRequestId, response)
end)

--- Each migration runs once, in order, and is recorded in fivefly_schema.

local MIGRATIONS <const> = {

                thumbnail TEXT NULL,

                skip_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                PRIMARY KEY (user_id, video_id),
                KEY idx_fivefly_track_stats_user_play (user_id, play_count),
                KEY idx_fivefly_track_stats_user_skip (user_id, skip_count)
            ) DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4
            ]]
        }
    }
}

FiveFly.Database.LatestVersion = MIGRATIONS[#MIGRATIONS].version

local function getCurrentVersion()
    MySQL.query.await([[
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fivefly_schema (
            version INT NOT NULL,
            applied_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            PRIMARY KEY (version)
        )
    ]])

    local rows = MySQL.query.await("SELECT MAX(version) AS version FROM fivefly_schema") or {}
    return tonumber(rows[1] and rows[1].version) or 0
end

local function runMigrations()
    local current = getCurrentVersion()

    for _, migration in ipairs(MIGRATIONS) do
        if migration.version > current then
            FiveFly.Log("info", FiveFly.T("log.migration_applying", migration.version, migration.name))

            for _, statement in ipairs(migration.statements) do
                MySQL.query.await(statement)
            end

            MySQL.insert.await("INSERT INTO fivefly_schema (version) VALUES (?)", { migration.version })
        end
    end
end

MySQL.ready(function()
    local ok, err = pcall(runMigrations)

    if not ok then
        FiveFly.Log("error", FiveFly.T("log.migration_failed", tostring(err)))
        return
    end

    FiveFly.Database.ready = true
    FiveFly.Log("debug", "database schema at version %d", FiveFly.Database.LatestVersion)
end)
