FiveFly.Repo = FiveFly.Repo or {}
FiveFly.Repo.Playlists = {}

local Playlists = FiveFly.Repo.Playlists
local Utils = FiveFly.Utils

local SHARE_CODE_ALPHABET <const> = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789"

---@class Playlist
---@field id integer
---@field name string
---@field trackCount integer
---@field cover string
---@field shareCode string
---@field visibility "public"|"private"
---@field ownerUserId? integer
---@field ownerName? string

local function normalizeVisibility(value)
    return Utils.Trim(value):lower() == "public" and "public" or "private"
end

---@return Playlist
function Playlists.MapRow(row)
    return {
        id = tonumber(row.id),
        name = tostring(row.name or "Playlist"),
        trackCount = tonumber(row.track_count) or 0,
        cover = tostring(row.cover or ""),
        shareCode = tostring(row.share_code or ""),
        visibility = normalizeVisibility(row.visibility),
        ownerUserId = tonumber(row.user_id),
        ownerName = row.owner_name and tostring(row.owner_name) or nil
    }
end

local function mapRows(rows)
    local playlists = {}

    for _, row in ipairs(rows or {}) do
        playlists[#playlists + 1] = Playlists.MapRow(row)
    end

    return playlists
end

local function generateShareCode()
    for _ = 1, 12 do
        local chars = {}

        for index = 1, 8 do
            local position = math.random(1, #SHARE_CODE_ALPHABET)
            chars[index] = SHARE_CODE_ALPHABET:sub(position, position)
        end

        local code = table.concat(chars)
        local taken = MySQL.query.await("SELECT 1 FROM fivefly_playlists WHERE share_code = ? LIMIT 1", { code }) or {}

        if not taken[1] then
            return code
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function isOwner(userId, playlistId)
    local rows = MySQL.query.await("SELECT 1 FROM fivefly_playlists WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ? LIMIT 1", { playlistId, userId }) or {}
    return rows[1] ~= nil
end

local function countPlaylists(userId)
    local rows = MySQL.query.await("SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM fivefly_playlists WHERE user_id = ?", { userId }) or {}
    return tonumber(rows[1] and rows[1].total) or 0
end

local function get(userId, playlistId)
    local rows = MySQL.query.await([[
        SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.name, p.cover, p.share_code, p.visibility,
               (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fivefly_playlist_tracks t WHERE t.playlist_id = p.id) AS track_count
        FROM fivefly_playlists p
        WHERE p.id = ? AND p.user_id = ?
        LIMIT 1
    ]], { playlistId, userId }) or {}

    return rows[1] and Playlists.MapRow(rows[1]) or nil
end

---@return Playlist[]
function Playlists.GetByUser(userId)
    return mapRows(MySQL.query.await([[
        SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.name, p.cover, p.share_code, p.visibility, COUNT(t.video_id) AS track_count
        FROM fivefly_playlists p
        LEFT JOIN fivefly_playlist_tracks t ON t.playlist_id = p.id
        WHERE p.user_id = ?
        GROUP BY p.id, p.user_id, p.name, p.cover, p.share_code, p.visibility, p.created_at
        ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
    ]], { userId }))
end

--- Public playlists of the given users, with the owner's display name.
---@param userIds integer[]
---@return table<integer, Playlist[]> playlists grouped by owner id
function Playlists.GetPublicByUsers(userIds)
    local grouped = {}

    if #userIds == 0 then
        return grouped
    end

    local rows = MySQL.query.await(([[
        SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.name, p.cover, p.share_code, p.visibility, pr.display_name AS owner_name,
               COUNT(t.video_id) AS track_count
        FROM fivefly_playlists p
        LEFT JOIN fivefly_playlist_tracks t ON t.playlist_id = p.id
        LEFT JOIN fivefly_profiles pr ON pr.user_id = p.user_id
        WHERE p.visibility = 'public' AND p.user_id IN (%s)
        GROUP BY p.id, p.user_id, p.name, p.cover, p.share_code, p.visibility, pr.display_name, p.created_at
        ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
    ]]):format(string.rep("?", #userIds, ",")), userIds) or {}

    for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
        local playlist = Playlists.MapRow(row)
        local list = grouped[playlist.ownerUserId] or {}

        if #list < 20 then
            list[#list + 1] = playlist
        end

        grouped[playlist.ownerUserId] = list
    end

    return grouped
end

---@return Playlist[]
function Playlists.SearchPublic(query)
    local pattern = "%" .. query .. "%"

    return mapRows(MySQL.query.await([[
        SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.name, p.cover, p.share_code, p.visibility, pr.display_name AS owner_name,
               COUNT(t.video_id) AS track_count
        FROM fivefly_playlists p
        LEFT JOIN fivefly_playlist_tracks t ON t.playlist_id = p.id
        LEFT JOIN fivefly_profiles pr ON pr.user_id = p.user_id
        WHERE p.visibility = 'public' AND (p.name LIKE ? OR pr.display_name LIKE ?)
        GROUP BY p.id, p.user_id, p.name, p.cover, p.share_code, p.visibility, pr.display_name, p.created_at
        ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
        LIMIT 12
    ]], { pattern, pattern }))
end

---@return Playlist|nil playlist, string|nil error
function Playlists.Create(userId, name)
    local safeName = Utils.Trim(name):sub(1, Config.Library.MaxPlaylistNameLength)

    if safeName == "" then
        return nil, "invalid_name"
    end

    if countPlaylists(userId) >= Config.Library.MaxPlaylists then
        return nil, "playlist_limit"
    end

    local shareCode = generateShareCode()
    local id = MySQL.insert.await([[
        INSERT INTO fivefly_playlists (user_id, name, share_code) VALUES (?, ?, ?)
    ]], { userId, safeName, shareCode })

    return get(userId, id), nil
end

---@return boolean success, string|nil error
function Playlists.Delete(userId, playlistId)
    local id = tonumber(playlistId)

    if not id then
        return false, "invalid_playlist"
    end

    if not isOwner(userId, id) then
        return false, "playlist_not_found"
    end

    MySQL.update.await("DELETE FROM fivefly_playlist_tracks WHERE playlist_id = ?", { id })
    MySQL.update.await("DELETE FROM fivefly_playlists WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?", { id, userId })

    return true, nil
end

---@return Track[]|nil tracks, string|nil error
function Playlists.GetTracks(userId, playlistId)
    local id = tonumber(playlistId)

    if not id then
        return nil, "invalid_playlist"
    end

    if not isOwner(userId, id) then
        return nil, "playlist_not_found"
    end

    return FiveFly.Repo.Tracks.MapRows(MySQL.query.await([[
        SELECT video_id, title, thumbnail, duration, author
        FROM fivefly_playlist_tracks
        WHERE playlist_id = ?
        ORDER BY position ASC, created_at ASC
    ]], { id })), nil
end

---@return boolean success, string|nil error
function Playlists.SetCover(userId, playlistId, cover)
    local id = tonumber(playlistId)

    if not id then
        return false, "invalid_playlist"
    end

    if cover == "" then
        return false, "invalid_cover"
    end

    if not isOwner(userId, id) then
        return false, "playlist_not_found"
    end

    MySQL.update.await("UPDATE fivefly_playlists SET cover = ? WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?", { cover, id, userId })

    return true, nil
end

---@return string|nil visibility, string|nil error
function Playlists.SetVisibility(userId, playlistId, visibility)
    local id = tonumber(playlistId)

    if not id then
        return nil, "invalid_playlist"
    end

    if not isOwner(userId, id) then
        return nil, "playlist_not_found"
    end

    local safeVisibility = normalizeVisibility(visibility)
    MySQL.update.await("UPDATE fivefly_playlists SET visibility = ? WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?", { safeVisibility, id, userId })

    return safeVisibility, nil
end

--- Copies a playlist (public or private) by its share code into the user's library.
---@return Playlist|nil playlist, string|nil error
function Playlists.ImportByCode(userId, shareCode)
    local code = Utils.Trim(shareCode):upper():sub(1, 12)

    if code == "" or not code:match("^[%w]+$") then
        return nil, "invalid_share_code"
    end

    local rows = MySQL.query.await("SELECT id, name, cover FROM fivefly_playlists WHERE share_code = ? LIMIT 1", { code }) or {}
    local source = rows[1]

    if not source then
        return nil, "playlist_not_found"
    end

    if countPlaylists(userId) >= Config.Library.MaxPlaylists then
        return nil, "playlist_limit"
    end

    local baseName = Utils.Trim(source.name or "Playlist"):sub(1, Config.Library.MaxPlaylistNameLength - 7)
    local name = (baseName ~= "" and baseName or "Playlist") .. " (copy)"
    local newId = MySQL.insert.await([[
        INSERT INTO fivefly_playlists (user_id, name, cover, share_code) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
    ]], { userId, name, Utils.NormalizeHttpUrl(source.cover), generateShareCode() })

    MySQL.insert.await([[
        INSERT INTO fivefly_playlist_tracks (playlist_id, video_id, title, thumbnail, duration, author, position)
        SELECT ?, video_id, title, thumbnail, duration, author, position
        FROM fivefly_playlist_tracks
        WHERE playlist_id = ?
        ORDER BY position ASC, created_at ASC
        LIMIT ?
    ]], { newId, tonumber(source.id), Config.Library.MaxTracksPerPlaylist })

    return get(userId, newId), nil
end

--- Adds a normalized track at the end of the playlist. The first track with artwork becomes the cover.
---@return boolean success, string|nil error
function Playlists.AddTrack(userId, playlistId, track)
    local playlist = get(userId, tonumber(playlistId))

    if not playlist then
        return false, tonumber(playlistId) and "playlist_not_found" or "invalid_playlist"
    end

    if playlist.trackCount >= Config.Library.MaxTracksPerPlaylist then
        return false, "playlist_full"
    end

    MySQL.insert.await([[
        INSERT INTO fivefly_playlist_tracks (playlist_id, video_id, title, thumbnail, duration, author, position)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
            title = VALUES(title),
            thumbnail = VALUES(thumbnail),
            duration = VALUES(duration),
            author = VALUES(author)
    ]], { playlist.id, track.videoId, track.title, track.thumbnail, track.duration, track.author, playlist.trackCount + 1 })

    if playlist.cover == "" and track.thumbnail ~= "" then
        MySQL.update.await("UPDATE fivefly_playlists SET cover = ? WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?", { track.thumbnail, playlist.id, userId })
    end

    return true, nil
end

---@return boolean success, string|nil error
function Playlists.RemoveTrack(userId, playlistId, videoId)
    local id = tonumber(playlistId)
    local safeVideoId = Utils.ExtractVideoId(videoId)

    if not id then
        return false, "invalid_playlist"
    end

    if safeVideoId == "" then
        return false, "invalid_track"
    end

    if not isOwner(userId, id) then
        return false, "playlist_not_found"
    end

    MySQL.update.await("DELETE FROM fivefly_playlist_tracks WHERE playlist_id = ? AND video_id = ?", { id, safeVideoId })

    return true, nil
end

---Sets the priority for the given vehicle. This is a hint for the audio system as to what LOD the
---vehicle should use.
---
---'High' priority will bump up the activation range significantly and prevent it
---from dropping when the vehicle is not within the view frustrum.
---
---'Max' will attempt to keep the vehicle at maximum LOD regardless of how far it is from the listener or what it is currently doing. Be careful with this!
---
---There is a hard limit of 5 simulataneous granular cars (including the player) so we are quite limited on the number
---we can play at once, so setting vehicles to max priority will reduce the number of engines availble for regular NPC vehicles
---
---```cpp
---enum eAudVehiclePriority {
---	AUDIO_VEHICLE_PRIORITY_NORMAL = 0,
---	AUDIO_VEHICLE_PRIORITY_MEDIUM = 1,
---	AUDIO_VEHICLE_PRIORITY_MAX = 2,
---	AUDIO_VEHICLE_PRIORITY_HIGH = 3,
---}
---```

---@param priority integer

FiveFly.Repo = FiveFly.Repo or {}
FiveFly.Repo.Profiles = {}

local Profiles = FiveFly.Repo.Profiles
local Utils = FiveFly.Utils

---@class Profile
---@field userId integer
---@field name string
---@field bio string
---@field avatar string
---@field isPublic boolean
---@field showActivity boolean
---@field following boolean
---@field followerCount integer
---@field followingCount integer
---@field publicPlaylists table[]

-- Selects a profile with its follower counts and whether the viewer (first parameter) follows it.
local PROFILE_COLUMNS <const> = [[
    p.user_id, p.display_name, p.bio, p.avatar, p.is_public, p.show_activity,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fivefly_follows f1 WHERE f1.target_user_id = p.user_id) AS follower_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fivefly_follows f2 WHERE f2.follower_user_id = p.user_id) AS following_count,
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fivefly_follows f3 WHERE f3.follower_user_id = ? AND f3.target_user_id = p.user_id) AS is_following
]]

local function normalizeDisplayName(value)
    local name = Utils.Trim(value):sub(1, 64)
    return name ~= "" and name or "Player"
end

local function isTrue(value, default)
    if value == nil then
        return default
    end

    return value == true or tonumber(value) == 1
end

---@return Profile
function Profiles.Map(row)
    return {
        userId = tonumber(row.user_id) or 0,
        name = normalizeDisplayName(row.display_name),
        bio = tostring(row.bio or ""),
        avatar = tostring(row.avatar or ""),
        isPublic = isTrue(row.is_public, true),
        showActivity = isTrue(row.show_activity, true),
        following = isTrue(row.is_following, false),
        followerCount = tonumber(row.follower_count) or 0,
        followingCount = tonumber(row.following_count) or 0,
        publicPlaylists = {}
    }
end

--- Creates the profile on first use and keeps the display name in sync with the character name.
function Profiles.Ensure(userId, displayName)
    MySQL.insert.await([[
        INSERT INTO fivefly_profiles (user_id, display_name)
        VALUES (?, ?)
        ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE display_name = VALUES(display_name)
    ]], { userId, normalizeDisplayName(displayName) })
end

---@return Profile|nil
function Profiles.Get(userId, viewerUserId)
    local rows = MySQL.query.await(([[
        SELECT %s
        FROM fivefly_profiles p
        WHERE p.user_id = ?
        LIMIT 1
    ]]):format(PROFILE_COLUMNS), { viewerUserId or 0, userId }) or {}

    return rows[1] and Profiles.Map(rows[1]) or nil
end

function Profiles.Update(userId, fields)
    MySQL.update.await([[
        UPDATE fivefly_profiles
        SET bio = ?, avatar = ?, is_public = ?, show_activity = ?
        WHERE user_id = ?
    ]], {
        Utils.Trim(fields.bio):sub(1, 140),
        Utils.NormalizeHttpUrl(fields.avatar),
        fields.isPublic and 1 or 0,
        fields.showActivity and 1 or 0,
        userId
    })
end

function Profiles.CanShowActivity(userId)
    local rows = MySQL.query.await([[
        SELECT is_public, show_activity FROM fivefly_profiles WHERE user_id = ? LIMIT 1
    ]], { userId }) or {}

    local row = rows[1]
    return row ~= nil and isTrue(row.is_public, true) and isTrue(row.show_activity, true)
end

---@return Profile[]
function Profiles.GetFollowing(userId)
    local rows = MySQL.query.await(([[
        SELECT %s
        FROM fivefly_follows f
        INNER JOIN fivefly_profiles p ON p.user_id = f.target_user_id
        WHERE f.follower_user_id = ? AND p.is_public = 1
        ORDER BY p.display_name ASC
        LIMIT 30
    ]]):format(PROFILE_COLUMNS), { userId, userId }) or {}

    local profiles = {}

    for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
        profiles[#profiles + 1] = Profiles.Map(row)
    end

    return profiles
end

--- Returns the subset of `userIds` followed by `followerUserId`, as a set.
---@param followerUserId integer
---@param userIds integer[]
---@return table<integer, boolean>
function Profiles.GetFollowedSet(followerUserId, userIds)
    local followed = {}

    if #userIds == 0 then
        return followed
    end

    local placeholders = string.rep("?", #userIds, ",")
    local params = { followerUserId }

    for _, id in ipairs(userIds) do
        params[#params + 1] = id
    end

    local rows = MySQL.query.await(([[
        SELECT target_user_id FROM fivefly_follows
        WHERE follower_user_id = ? AND target_user_id IN (%s)
    ]]):format(placeholders), params) or {}

    for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
        followed[tonumber(row.target_user_id)] = true
    end

    return followed
end

---@return boolean|nil following, string|nil error
function Profiles.ToggleFollow(followerUserId, targetUserId)
    local target = tonumber(targetUserId)

    if not target or target <= 0 or target == followerUserId then
        return nil, "invalid_profile"
    end

    local exists = MySQL.query.await("SELECT 1 FROM fivefly_profiles WHERE user_id = ? LIMIT 1", { target }) or {}

    if not exists[1] then
        return nil, "profile_not_found"
    end

    local removed = MySQL.update.await([[
        DELETE FROM fivefly_follows WHERE follower_user_id = ? AND target_user_id = ?
    ]], { followerUserId, target })

    if removed and removed > 0 then
        return false, nil
    end

    MySQL.insert.await([[
        INSERT IGNORE INTO fivefly_follows (follower_user_id, target_user_id) VALUES (?, ?)
    ]], { followerUserId, target })

    return true, nil
end

---@return Profile[]
function Profiles.Search(viewerUserId, query)
    local pattern = "%" .. query .. "%"
    local rows = MySQL.query.await(([[
        SELECT %s
        FROM fivefly_profiles p
        WHERE p.is_public = 1 AND (p.display_name LIKE ? OR p.bio LIKE ? OR p.user_id = ?)
        ORDER BY p.display_name ASC
        LIMIT 10
    ]]):format(PROFILE_COLUMNS), { viewerUserId, pattern, pattern, tonumber(query) or -1 }) or {}

    local profiles = {}

    for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
        profiles[#profiles + 1] = Profiles.Map(row)
    end

    return profiles
end

---[Native Documentation](https://docs.fivem.net/natives/?_0xD1B0F412F109EA5D)  
---Sets the smoothing style for a DEFAULT_SPLINE_CAMERA
---Ranges from 0 to 3 in rockstar scripts although there are actually 26
---
---```
---0: No lead-in or lead-out smoothing
---1: Smooth lead-in
---2: Smooth lead-out
---3: Both lead-in and lead-out are smoothed
---4-6: Longer speed up, lead-in, lead-out, and both in order as above. 
---6: see above, but missed a node in testing(?)
---7: Smoothed lead-in, longer smoothed lead-out
---8: Longer lead-in and lead-out than 6, didn't drop node
---9: Constant acceleration
---10: Constant deceleration. Dropped 2 nodes in testing.
---11: Same as 0
---12: 10 but slower lead-in, reaches end node less early
---13: Extremely close to 3, slightly longer lead-in/lead-out
---14: Constant acceleration, dropped last 2 nodes in testing and halted (?)
---15: Very similar to 10, did not drop any nodes.
---16: Long lead-in, dropped 2 nodes in testing, very long leadout.
---17: Constant acceleration, slower speed-up than 9
---18: Same as 17 is to 9, slightly longer lead-out, lingers at end node
---19: Very long lead in and out
---20: Very long, gradual lead-in acceleration at start, gets extremely fast
---21: Same as 20 but for constant deceleration
---22: 20 and 21 combined, long linger at end node. Dropped 2 nodes in testing
---23: Constant acceleration, doesn't complete path before it stops
---24: Same as 23 but with constant deceleration, but completes path
---25: 23 and 24 combined, insanely fast at middle.
---26: No noticable lead-in, misses last 2 nodes in testing
---27+: Alternates between 0 and 26
---```
---
---The above is documented and graphed at [Spline Cam Interp Graphs](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ejyiMcEYrhhQOL0mLe8664UN-vU4Oh-SBqQnVcKlFIk/edit?usp=sharing)
---
---Using 1-3 will result in misalignment from the passed durations for the spline nodes, the overall duration will remain but other nodes will be shortened if smoothing anything.
---
---Graph below demonstrates interpolation between 0-1000 and back 10 times.
---
---![](https://i.imgur.com/68htz5K.png)
---@param cam integer
---@param smoothingStyle integer
function SetCamSplineSmoothingStyle(cam, smoothingStyle) end

--[[ Cross-resource keybind registry: every `tlib.platform.bindKey` call reports
here, the only place two resources' bindings are visible together, since
`platform.keybindConflicts()` only sees its own VM (e.g. tLS's PA Mic and
tRadar's radar keys both claim B/RMENU, invisible to either resource alone).
A default key is a suggestion, not authority — the player's FiveM rebind wins
— so this only warns and never reassigns. The report is deferred
`REPORT_DELAY_MS` because resource start order is not guaranteed. ]]

local log = Logger.create('tLib/keybinds')

--- Every bind reported, keyed `group\1key` -> { {resource=, token=, label=}, ... }
local byKey = {}
--- Flat list, for `GetKeybinds`.
local all = {}

--- Long enough for every consumer to have started and registered; a bind
--- reported after this fires is still recorded, just not printed.
local REPORT_DELAY_MS = 10000

local reported = false

--- Upper-cased, because FiveM accepts either case and a consumer that writes
--- `'q'` would otherwise never match a consumer that writes `'Q'` — a collision
--- the registry reports as two separate, uncontested keys.
local function keyOf(entry)
    return tostring(entry.group or 'keyboard') .. '\1' .. tostring(entry.default or ''):upper()
end

--- Record one bind. Called by `platform.bindKey` in every consumer VM.
---
--- Total, not strict: a malformed entry is dropped, not raised. This runs inside
--- the consumer's bind path, and a keybind registry is not worth breaking a
--- resource's startup over.
local function report(entry)
    if type(entry) ~= 'table' then return end
    if type(entry.token) ~= 'string' or entry.token == '' then return end

    local record = {
        resource = tostring(entry.resource or '?'),
        token    = entry.token,
        label    = tostring(entry.label or entry.token),
        default  = tostring(entry.default or ''),
        group    = tostring(entry.group or 'keyboard'),
    }
    all[#all + 1] = record

    -- An unbound entry has no key to collide on; many share the empty string,
    -- and treating that as a collision would bury the real ones.
    if record.default == '' then return end

    local k = keyOf(record)
    byKey[k] = byKey[k] or {}
    local list = byKey[k]
    list[#list + 1] = record
end

--- Conflicts across every resource that reported.
--- Returns `{ { group =, key =, claims = { {resource=, token=, label=}, ... } }, ... }`
local function conflicts()
    local out = {}
    for k, claims in pairs(byKey) do
        if #claims > 1 then
            -- Two binds from the SAME resource on the same key are that
            -- resource's own business and its own check already reports them.
            -- Only flag it here when more than one product is involved.
            local resources, distinct = {}, 0
            for _, c in ipairs(claims) do
                if not resources[c.resource] then
                    resources[c.resource] = true
                    distinct = distinct + 1
                end
            end
            if distinct > 1 then
                local group, key = k:match('^(.-)\1(.*)$')
                out[#out + 1] = { group = group, key = key, claims = claims }
            end
        end
    end
    return out
end

Platform.export('tLib', 'ReportKeybind', report)
Platform.export('tLib', 'GetKeybinds', function() return all end)
Platform.export('tLib', 'GetKeybindConflicts', conflicts)

CreateThread(function()
    Wait(REPORT_DELAY_MS)
    if reported then return end
    reported = true

    local found = conflicts()
    if #found == 0 then return end

    log(('%d cross-resource keybind conflict(s) — both bindings fire on one press:')
        :format(#found), 2)
    for _, c in ipairs(found) do
        local parts = {}
        for _, claim in ipairs(c.claims) do
            parts[#parts + 1] = ('%s (%s)'):format(claim.label, claim.resource)
        end
        log(('  %s  ->  %s'):format(c.key, table.concat(parts, '  vs  ')), 2)
    end
    log('  A player rebind in GTA Settings > Key Bindings overrides the default.', 2)
end)

-- One editor and layout authority; consumers continue rendering their own HUDs.
HudLayout = {}
local H, S = HudLayout, HudLayoutSchema
local components, callbacks, saved = {}, {}, {}
local ui, active, generation, storageKey = nil, nil, 0, nil
local transitioning, stopped = false, false
-- Heartbeats arrive every 30s. Two missed beats indicate a dead renderer,
-- independently of focus: the generic ready handshake remains true after a crash.
local HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT_MS, FOCUS_LOSS_GRACE_MS = 65000, 1500
local function yes(value) return value == true or value == 1 end
local function dialogActive()
    return DialogExports and DialogExports.isActive and DialogExports.isActive()
end
local function competingInput()
    return (MenuPrompt and MenuPrompt.active())
        or (MenuInput and MenuInput.isTyping()) or dialogActive()
end
local rendererId
-- An interrupted draft, waiting for the next open. See the watchdog.
local recovered
local log = Logger.create('tLib/layout')
local function callable(fn)
    if type(fn) == 'function' then return true end
    if type(fn) ~= 'table' then return false end
    local mt = getmetatable(fn)
    return (type(mt) == 'table' and type(mt.__call) == 'function') or type(fn.__cfx_functionReference) == 'string'
end
local function owner()
    local name = Platform.getInvokingResource()
    if not S.id(name) then return nil end
    return name
end
-- The game resolution is the NUI viewport. Used only when the browser has not
-- supplied its own; the browser's value stays authoritative while editing.
local function screenViewport()
    if type(GetActiveScreenResolution) ~= 'function' then return nil end
    local ok, width, height = pcall(GetActiveScreenResolution)
    if not ok or not S.finite(width, 1, 16384) or not S.finite(height, 1, 16384) then return nil end
    return { width = width, height = height }
end
-- Heal on the way in, not only while editing: a widget saved off-screen at another
-- resolution must come back by itself, because the tool for rescuing it is the one
-- you cannot see to open.
local function heal(layout, component)
    local viewport = screenViewport()
    if not viewport then return layout end
    return S.constrain(layout, component, viewport) or layout
end
-- The one place the KVP record is written. Three callers -- editor Save, Reset,
-- and a live drag -- and they must not be able to disagree about its shape.
local function writeLayouts(layouts)
    if not storageKey then return true end
    local ok, err = pcall(function() SetResourceKvp(storageKey, json.encode({ version = 2, layouts = layouts })) end)
    if not ok then log('Could not save HUD layout: ' .. tostring(err), 4) end
    return ok
end
local function notify(component, phase)
    local fn = callbacks[component.key]
    if not fn then return end
    local layout = active and active.draft[component.key] or component.layout
    local ok, err = pcall(fn, { id = component.id, layout = S.copy(layout), width = component.width,
        height = component.height, phase = phase, editing = active ~= nil })
    if not ok then log('HUD callback failed for ' .. component.key .. ': ' .. tostring(err), 3) end
end
local function sortedComponents()
    local result = {}
    for _, component in pairs(components) do result[#result + 1] = component end
    table.sort(result, function(a, b) return a.key < b.key end)
    return result
end
local function releaseFocus()
    if not competingInput() then Platform.setInputMode(ui, 0) end
    -- Dialogs share these adapter locks; native menus suppress their own controls.
    if not dialogActive() then
        Platform.setIgnoreMoveInput(false)
        Platform.setIgnoreLookInput(false)
    end
end
local function close(save)
    local session = active
    if not session then return false end
    if save then
        local nextSaved, count = {}, 0
        for key, value in pairs(session.draft) do
            if components[key] and components[key].persist then
                nextSaved[key] = S.copy(value); count = count + 1
            end
        end
        local retained = {}
        for key in pairs(saved) do retained[#retained + 1] = key end
        table.sort(retained)
        for _, key in ipairs(retained) do
            if not nextSaved[key] and count < 256 and (not components[key] or components[key].persist) then
                nextSaved[key] = saved[key]; count = count + 1
            end
        end
        if not writeLayouts(nextSaved) then return false end
        saved = nextSaved
        for key, value in pairs(session.draft) do if components[key] then components[key].layout = S.copy(value) end end
    end
    transitioning = true
    active = nil
    for _, timer in pairs(session.pending) do Platform.clearTimeout(timer) end
    Platform.sendUIEvent(ui, 'layoutClose', { session = session.id })
    -- Do not unlock a known tLib successor (including a pending dialog). For
    -- external NUI, releasing our own resource's focus entry does not acquire or
    -- refocus theirs. Never try SetNuiFocus(true) from a watchdog.
    if session.focused then releaseFocus() end
    if session.releaseBlur then session.releaseBlur() end
    for _, component in ipairs(sortedComponents()) do notify(component, save and 'commit' or 'rollback') end
    transitioning = false
    return true
end
function H.isEditing() return active ~= nil or transitioning end
function H.close() return close(false) end

-- The safety net
-- Restore factory placements without needing the editor, because the editor is
-- the thing you cannot reach once a widget has been lost. Any open session is
-- discarded first: a draft is never worth more than being able to see your HUD.
--
-- `only` is a set of component keys, or nil for every component AND every stored
-- record, including records belonging to resources that are not running now --
-- those are exactly the ones nothing else can clean up.
local function resetLayouts(only)
    if active or transitioning then close(false) end
    local touched = {}
    for _, component in ipairs(sortedComponents()) do
        if not only or only[component.key] then
            saved[component.key] = nil
            -- S.copy of a validated default, then healed against the live
            -- resolution: the result is sane by construction whatever was stored.
            component.layout = heal(S.copy(component.defaults), component)
            touched[#touched + 1] = component
        end
    end
    if only then
        for key in pairs(only) do saved[key] = nil end
    else
        saved = {}
    end
    -- The second return value is whether the KVP record actually went to disk. The
    -- in-memory reset has already happened either way and the consumers below are
    -- about to be told 'commit', so a failed write means the widget looks fixed now
    -- and comes back broken on the next load -- the one thing the player must not be
    -- told is that it was cleared.
    local persisted = writeLayouts(saved)
    -- 'commit' and not 'restore': a consumer that keeps its own store has to be
    -- told to write this down, or its own bad record wins again on the next load.
    for _, component in ipairs(touched) do notify(component, 'commit') end
    return #touched, persisted
end
function H.resetAll() return resetLayouts(nil) end

-- Live placement
-- A device UI that lets the player drag it by its own background has to write
-- the result HERE. Keeping its own copy would make a dragged position a
-- second-class one: not healed on the next resolution change, not cleared by
-- Reset, and disagreeing with the editor about where the widget is. So this is
-- the editor's Save for exactly one component -- same validation, same heal,
-- same KVP record, same 'commit' notification -- and nothing else is offered.
local function setLayout(key, value)
    local component = components[key]
    if not component then return false, 'Unknown HUD component' end
    -- The editor is a transaction over every component at once; a live write
    -- landing inside one would be thrown away by Cancel without saying so.
    if H.isEditing() then return false, 'Close the layout editor first' end
    local layout = S.layout(value, component)
    if not layout then return false, 'Invalid layout' end
    layout = heal(layout, component)
    if component.persist then
        local count = 0
        for _ in pairs(saved) do count = count + 1 end
        if saved[key] == nil and count >= 256 then return false, 'Saved HUD layout limit reached' end
        -- Persist BEFORE announcing: a consumer told 'commit' has every right to
        -- believe the position survives a reload, so a failed write must not
        -- reach it as success, and must not leave a half-applied record behind.
        local previous = saved[key]
        saved[key] = S.copy(layout)
        if not writeLayouts(saved) then saved[key] = previous; return false, 'Could not save HUD layout' end
    end
    component.layout = layout
    notify(component, 'commit')
    return true
end

local function register(name, id, options, fn)
    if H.isEditing() then return false, 'Close the layout editor before registering a component' end
    local component = S.component(name, id, options)
    if not component or not callable(fn) then return false, 'Invalid HUD component or callback' end
    local count, ownCount = 0, 0
    for _, existing in pairs(components) do
        count = count + 1
        if existing.owner == name then ownCount = ownCount + 1 end
    end
    if not components[component.key] and (count >= 64 or ownCount >= 16) then return false, 'HUD component limit reached' end
    -- Consumer-owned placement always starts from the supplied state. Retire any
    -- prior tLib record even if this component unregisters before the next Finish,
    -- otherwise the retained-record pass would resurrect the old placement.
    -- Disk cleanup remains transactional: only a successful Finish writes KVP.
    if not component.persist then saved[component.key] = nil end
    -- Order: our own record (only when we are the store), then the consumer's
    -- current placement, then the factory default. Every one of the three is
    -- validated, so garbage at any step falls through to the next rather than
    -- being trusted, and the last step cannot fail.
    component.layout = (component.persist and S.layout(saved[component.key], component))
        or (component.initial and S.copy(component.initial))
        or S.copy(component.defaults)
    component.layout = heal(component.layout, component)
    components[component.key], callbacks[component.key] = component, fn
    notify(component, 'restore')
    return true
end
local function unregister(key, notifyOwner)
    local component, callback = components[key], callbacks[key]
    if not component then return false end
    components[key], callbacks[key] = nil, nil
    if active then
        active.draft[key] = nil
        if active.pending[key] then Platform.clearTimeout(active.pending[key]); active.pending[key] = nil end
        Platform.sendUIEvent(ui, 'layoutRemove', { session = active.id, key = key })
        if notifyOwner ~= false and callback then
            pcall(callback, { id = component.id, layout = S.copy(component.layout), width = component.width,
                height = component.height, phase = 'rollback', editing = false })
        end
    end
    return true
end
local function addDemo()
    if components['tLib:demo'] then return true end
    return register('tLib', 'demo', { label = 'tLib test HUD', width = 240, height = 90,
        -- Offsets are reference pixels over 1080: 48px in from the bottom-right corner.
        defaults = { x = -48 / 1080, y = -48 / 1080, scale = 1, visible = true, anchor = 'bottom-right' } }, function() end)
end
local function open(name)
    if stopped then return false, 'HUD layout service is stopping' end
    if not _TLIB_IS_FIVEM then return false, 'HUD editing is currently FiveM-only' end
    if H.isEditing() then return false, 'HUD editor is already open; use /tlibhud cancel to discard' end
    if not Platform.isNUIReady() then return false, 'UI is not ready' end
    if (type(IsNuiFocused) == 'function' and yes(IsNuiFocused()))
        or competingInput() then return false, 'Another UI owns or is waiting for input' end
    local list = sortedComponents()
    if #list == 0 then return false, 'No HUD components registered' end
    generation = generation + 1
    active = { id = generation, owner = name, draft = {}, pending = {}, revisions = {}, touched = Platform.now(), focused = false }
    -- Re-heal on open: the resolution may have changed since registration.
    for _, component in ipairs(list) do active.draft[component.key] = heal(component.layout, component) end
    -- Carry over work the watchdog interrupted, once. Healed the same way as a
    -- fresh draft, because the resolution may have changed in between, and
    -- dropped after use so a stale draft cannot resurface a third time.
    if recovered then
        for key, value in pairs(recovered.draft) do
            if components[key] then active.draft[key] = heal(value, components[key]) end
        end
        recovered = nil
    end
    local safezone = type(GetSafeZoneSize) == 'function' and GetSafeZoneSize() or 1
    Platform.sendUIEvent(ui, 'layoutOpen', { session = active.id, components = list,
        safezone = S.finite(safezone, 0.5, 1) and safezone or 1 })
    Platform.setInputMode(ui, 1)
    Platform.setIgnoreMoveInput(true)
    Platform.setIgnoreLookInput(true)
    active.focused = true
    -- The effects service is shared with dialogs; closing the editor releases only its lease.
    if UIEffects and UIEffects.acquireBlur then
        local token = UIEffects.acquireBlur(name)
        active.releaseBlur = function() UIEffects.releaseBlur(token) end
    end
    for _, component in ipairs(list) do notify(component, 'preview') end
    return true
end

function H.init(webui)
    ui = webui
    if _TLIB_IS_FIVEM then
        local profile = GetConvar('tlib_hud_profile', '')
        if profile == '' and type(GetCurrentServerEndpoint) == 'function' then profile = GetCurrentServerEndpoint() or '' end
        if profile ~= '' then
            -- The 'v1' in the key name is historical and is not the payload version;
            -- renaming it would orphan every existing player's saved placement.
            storageKey = 'tlib:hud:v1:' .. tostring(GetHashKey(profile))
            local raw = GetResourceKvpString(storageKey)
            if type(raw) == 'string' and #raw <= 131072 then
                local ok, value = pcall(json.decode, raw)
                local version = type(value) == 'table' and value.version or nil
                if ok and (version == 1 or version == 2) and type(value.layouts) == 'table' then
                    local count = 0
                    for key, layout in pairs(value.layouts) do
                        -- v1 offsets were fractions of viewport width; convert before validating,
                        -- because a converted 16:9 value can legitimately exceed the old +/-1 bound.
                        if version == 1 then layout = S.migrate(layout) end
                        local valid = S.layout(layout, { minScale = 0.1, maxScale = 4, canHide = true, canScale = true })
                        if type(key) == 'string' and #key <= 161 and valid and count < 256 then
                            saved[key] = valid; count = count + 1
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        else log('HUD layouts are session-only: no server endpoint or tlib_hud_profile is available', 3) end
    end
    register('tLib', 'toasts', { label = 'Notifications', width = 360, height = 160, canHide = false,
        defaults = { x = -24 / 1080, y = 24 / 1080, scale = 1, visible = true, anchor = 'top-right' } }, function(data)
        Platform.sendUIEvent(ui, 'toastLayout', data)
    end)
    -- There is no GetHudLayoutCapabilities export: it returned hardcoded `true`
    -- flags naming features no released tLib had, and consumers' pcall probes of
    -- it collapsed `layout` into `defaults` on no answer, which broke the shared
    -- editor for tRadio. RegisterHudComponent takes `layout` (current position)
    -- alongside `defaults` (Reset target), x/y as ratios of a 1080px reference
    -- height, and SetHudLayout/ResetHudLayout exist unconditionally.
    Platform.export('tLib', 'RegisterHudComponent', function(id, options, fn)
        local name = owner()
        if not name then return false, 'Cannot identify calling resource' end
        return register(name, id, options, fn)
    end)
    Platform.export('tLib', 'UnregisterHudComponent', function(id)
        local name = owner()
        if not name or not S.id(id) then return false end
        return unregister(name .. ':' .. id)
    end)
    Platform.export('tLib', 'GetHudLayout', function(id)
        local name = owner()
        local component = name and S.id(id) and components[name .. ':' .. id]
        return component and S.copy(component.layout) or nil
    end)
    Platform.export('tLib', 'SetHudLayout', function(id, layout)
        -- An exception inside an export reaches the caller as `undefined`, which
        -- resurfaces as a JSON parse error at the far end. Never let one out.
        local name = owner()
        if not name or not S.id(id) then return false, 'Cannot identify calling resource' end
        local ok, result, err = pcall(setLayout, name .. ':' .. id, layout)
        if not ok then return false, tostring(result) end
        return result == true, err
    end)
    Platform.export('tLib', 'OpenHudEditor', function(options)
        local name = owner()
        if not name then return false, 'Cannot identify calling resource' end
        if type(options) == 'table' and options.demo == true then addDemo() end
        return open(name)
    end)
    Platform.export('tLib', 'ResetHudLayout', function(id)
        -- No owner check: this is the recovery path, and refusing to un-break a
        -- HUD because the caller could not be identified helps nobody.
        -- Parenthesised: the export's documented answer is a count, and resetLayouts
        -- also returns whether the write landed. Forwarding both would change this
        -- export's arity for every consumer already calling it.
        local name = owner()
        if id == nil then return (resetLayouts(nil)) end
        if not name or not S.id(id) then return 0 end
        return (resetLayouts({ [name .. ':' .. id] = true }))
    end)
    Platform.export('tLib', 'CloseHudEditor', function()
        local name = owner()
        if not active or active.owner ~= name then return false end
        return close(false)
    end)
    Platform.onUIRequest(ui, 'layoutPreview', function(data, reply)
        if type(data) ~= 'table' or not active or data.session ~= active.id or type(data.key) ~= 'string' then
            return reply({ ok = false })
        end
        local component = components[data.key]
        if not component or not S.finite(data.revision, 1, 1000000000) or data.revision % 1 ~= 0 then
            return reply({ ok = false })
        end
        if data.revision <= (active.revisions[data.key] or 0) then return reply({ ok = true, stale = true }) end
        local layout = S.layout(data.layout, component)
        -- The editor's own viewport is authoritative; fall back to the game
        -- resolution only if it sent none, and refuse rather than guess 1080p.
        if layout then layout = S.constrain(layout, component, data.viewport or screenViewport()) end
        if not layout then return reply({ ok = false }) end
        active.revisions[data.key] = data.revision
        active.draft[data.key], active.touched = layout, Platform.now()
        local session, key = active, data.key
        if not session.pending[key] then
            session.pending[key] = Platform.setTimeout(function()
                session.pending[key] = nil
                if active == session and components[key] == component then notify(component, 'preview') end
            end, 16)
        end
        reply({ ok = true })
    end)
    Platform.onUIRequest(ui, 'layoutFinish', function(data, reply)
        if type(data) ~= 'table' or not active or data.session ~= active.id or type(data.save) ~= 'boolean' then
            return reply({ ok = false })
        end
        reply({ ok = close(data.save) })
    end)
    Platform.onUIRequest(ui, 'layoutReady', function(data, reply)
        if type(data) ~= 'table' or type(data.renderer) ~= 'string' or #data.renderer > 100 then
            return reply({ ok = false })
        end
        if rendererId and rendererId ~= data.renderer then close(false) end
        rendererId = data.renderer
        if components['tLib:toasts'] then notify(components['tLib:toasts'], active and 'preview' or 'restore') end
        reply({ ok = true })
    end)
    Platform.onUIRequest(ui, 'layoutHeartbeat', function(data, reply)
        local valid = type(data) == 'table' and active and data.session == active.id
        if valid then active.touched = Platform.now() end
        reply({ ok = valid == true })
    end)
    local function resourceStopped(name)
        local self = type(GetCurrentResourceName) == 'function' and GetCurrentResourceName() or 'tLib'
        if name == self then stopped = true; close(false); ui = nil end
        if active and active.owner == name then close(false) end
        local remove = {}
        for key, component in pairs(components) do if component.owner == name then remove[#remove + 1] = key end end
        for _, key in ipairs(remove) do unregister(key, false) end
    end
    if _TLIB_IS_FIVEM then
        AddEventHandler('onClientResourceStop', resourceStopped)
        RegisterCommand('tlibhud', function(_, args)
            local action = args and args[1]
            -- Player escape hatch is intentionally not restricted to the export
            -- owner. F8: tlibhud cancel works even when the browser cannot reply.
            if action == 'cancel' or action == 'close' then close(false); return end
            -- The unbrick command. Works with the editor shut, with the editor
            -- wedged open, and with every widget dragged off the screen.
            if action == 'reset' then
                local count, persisted = resetLayouts(nil)
                if persisted then
                    log(('Reset %d HUD component(s) to their default placement and cleared the saved layout.'):format(count), 3)
                else
                    log(('Reset %d HUD component(s) for this session, but the saved layout could NOT be cleared -- '
                        .. 'the old placement will come back on the next load. See the error above.'):format(count), 2)
                end
                return
            end
            if action and action ~= 'demo' and action ~= 'open' then
                log('Usage: /tlibhud [demo|open|cancel|reset] (no arguments toggles; closing discards; reset restores defaults)', 3)
                return
            end
            if active and action ~= 'open' then close(false); return end
            if action == 'demo' then addDemo() end
            local ok, err = open('tLib')
            if not ok then log(err, 3) end
        end, false)
        Platform.createThread(function()
            while ui do
                local session, now = active, Platform.now()
                if session then
                    local reason
                    if competingInput() then reason = 'another tLib UI owns input'
                    elseif now - session.touched > HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT_MS then reason = 'renderer stopped responding'
                    elseif type(IsNuiFocused) == 'function' then
                        if yes(IsNuiFocused()) then session.focusLostAt = nil
                        else
                            session.focusLostAt = session.focusLostAt or now
                            if now - session.focusLostAt >= FOCUS_LOSS_GRACE_MS then reason = 'NUI focus was lost' end
                        end
                    end
                    if reason and active == session then
                        -- The draft survives an involuntary close: it used to be
                        -- discarded, costing a player every edit on a momentary focus
                        -- blip, since `IsNuiFocused()` is a global signal any other
                        -- resource's NUI focus trips. Closing itself must stay — a
                        -- stuck cursor is worse, and a Lua test pins that — but an
                        -- ambiguous signal must not delete work; reopening restores it.
                        -- S.copy accepts one layout, not the owner:id map.
                        local draft = {}
                        for key, value in pairs(session.draft) do draft[key] = S.copy(value) end
                        recovered = { owner = session.owner, draft = draft }
                        log('HUD editor closed: ' .. reason
                            .. '. Your changes were kept -- reopen with /tlibhud to carry on.', 3)
                        close(false)
                    end
                end
                Platform.wait(250)
            end
        end)
    end
    Platform.onShutdown(function() stopped = true; close(false); ui = nil end)
end
return H

        if type(v) == 'function' then
            t[k] = Platform.storeCallback(v)
        end
    end
    return t
end)

Logger.init(ui)
Logger.registerExports()

-- theme first, everything else depends on it
Theme.init(ui)

-- Default theme (neutral dark, blue accents) is baked into the UI CSS; override
-- with AddTheme + SetTheme.

Toast.init(ui)

Dialog.init(ui)
HudLayout.init(ui)

-- The menu engine. It takes no focus and draws nothing on its own: until a resource
-- registers a namespace and a catalog, this installs the NUI callbacks, the open
-- command and the key slots and then sits idle.
MenuClient.init(ui)

Platform.onShutdown(function()
    if _TLIB_IS_FIVEM then
        -- setKeepInputActive is a separate latch; releasing focus does not clear it.
        SetNuiFocusKeepInput(false)
        SetNuiFocus(false, false)
    end
    Platform.destroyUI(ui)
    ui = nil
end)

-- Defer readiness signals until the NUI page has loaded its JS bundle and
-- registered its window message listeners. The callback runs once the browser
-- posts '__tlib_nui_ready' back to Lua, at which point the adapter flushes any
-- SendNUIMessage calls buffered during load.
local _hasLoaded = false

Platform.onNUIReady(function()
    _hasLoaded = true
    -- The menu engine does not start here: it waits for the browser's own
    -- `menu_ready` callback (carrying the first snapshot request), since a loaded
    -- page is not the same as a mounted menu component ready for a catalog.
end)

Platform.wrapExport('tLib', 'HasLoaded', function() return _hasLoaded end)
